name: Cavalry Pick

description.name: Armor-Piercing
description.value: An Armor-Piercing weapon is a Melee weapon designed to punch through armor or thick hide. When you make an attack roll using an Armor-Piercing weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll if your target is wearing armor or has an Armor Class of 18 or higher.

description.name: Momentum
description.value: Momentum weapons allow you to deliver devastating attacks as part of rapid movement. When you hit with a Momentum weapon after you moved 20 feet or more in a straight line during the same turn, upgrade the damage dice to the weapon's Momentum Dice value.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

properties: an armor-piercing weapon is a melee weapon designed to punch through armor or thick hide. when you make an attack roll using an armor-piercing weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll if your target is wearing armor or has an armor class of 18 or higher.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Returning
description.value: A Returning weapon allows you to hurl the weapon in such a way that it returns to you. When you make a ranged attack with a Returning weapon, the weapon returns to you immediately after hitting or missing the target. You can catch the weapon if you have a hand free to do so.

name: Charged Gauntlets
type: very rare (requires attunement by a monk)

description.value: These light gauntlets are made from cloth woven from the hair of a fiend and reinforced with the scales of a dragon. The gauntlets are washed with an alchemical formula made from elemental fluid and undead dust. They are then powered with a rare animus collected from an aberration.

Each time you hit with an Unarmed Strike while attuned to these magic gauntlets they gain one charge. The gauntlets can have up to 10 charges. Any unexpended charges disappear when you take a Long Rest or roll Initiative.
While the gauntlets have at least one charge, your Unarmed Strikes deal Lightning damage instead of its normal damage type.
While the gauntlets have 5 or more charges, your Unarmed Strikes deal an additional **2d6** Lightning damage and push the target 10 feet away from you on a hit.
You can expend 2 charges from the gauntlets to cast the __Shield__ spell.
You can expend 10 charges from the gauntlets to cast __Destructive Wave__ or __Wall of Force__, using your monk's focus saving throw DC.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating Charged Gauntlets requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Aberrant Animus
**[Dust]**: Undead Dust
**[Fluid]**: Elemental Fluid
**[Hair]**: Hair from a Fiend
**[Hide]**: Scales from a Blue or Bronze Dragon

description.value: While wearing these gloves, you can take a Magic action to produce an illusory image that fits in the palm of your hand. The image lasts for 1 minute or until your *Concentration* ends (as if you were *Concentrating* on a spell). The image can't create sound, light, smell, or any other sensory effect. Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it.

If a creature takes a Study action to examine the image, the creature can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (*Investigation*) check contested by your Charisma (*Deception*) check. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the illusion becomes faint to the creature.

This charm resembles a large gnat. It is made of the spores of dead mushrooms; the mandibles of an insectoid creature are placed upon it. The charm is coated in an acidic bile and held together by dried mucus. It smells of bugs and rot.

When an enemy within 5 feet of you scores a Critical Hit on an attack made against you, you can cause the enemy to become Burning (2d6 Necrotic). While the target is Burning in this way, you have Advantage on attacks against the target.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Charm of Swarms requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Acidic Bile
**[Fluid]**: Mucus
**[Natural Weapon]**: Spores
**[Natural Weapon]**: Mandibles

description.value: Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.
A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

description.name: Delerium Properties
description.value: All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

entries: Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.

Unless contained within an __Antimagic Field__, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points. However, delerium geodes release a random [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) when destroyed.

description.name: Delerium Hazards
description.value: When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

description.name: Delerium Harvesting
description.value: Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

description.name: Uses for Delerium
description.value: Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

description.name: Spell Component
description.value: Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

description.name: Magic Items
description.value: Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

description.name: Stable Delerium
description.value: The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

description.name: Delerium Dust
description.value: Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an __Antimagic Field__. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Chunk of Oozing Fungus

description.value: This fist-sized fungal growth is a pallid color, is oozy and lumpy, and frequently fills the air with spores. The fungus has the following properties.

description.name: Spore Cloud
description.value: As a Magic action, you can throw the fungus up to 30 feet. The fungus is destroyed and explodes into a cloud of spores in a 30-foot Sphere centered on that point. Each creature other than you in the area must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes **3d8** Poison damage and has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. A creature that fails this save by 5 or more also has the Incapacitated condition. On a successful save, a target takes half damage only.

description.name: Regrow
description.value: You can grow another Chunk of Oozing Fungus by coughing green-black spores into your hand as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you must succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or your Hit Point maximum decreases by 5.

description.name: Fungal Curse
description.value: You have a -1 penalty to Constitution saving throws. This penalty increases by 1 immediately after you succeed or fail on the saving throw from the Regrow property.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

description.value: This floor-length leather duster is the color of dying embers. You have a +2 bonus to Armor Class while wearing this armor.

The coat has 3 charges. When you hit a creature with a melee attack, and that creature is not at its Hit Point maximum, you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra **1d10** Fire damage to the target. The coat regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

This steel circlet is forged from a construct and set with a gemstone animus containing a fiend. After being cleansed in the fires of a dragon's breath, this holy circlet glimmers with radiant energy.
When you cast a spell of level 1 or higher that restores Hit Points to a creature, that creature gains Valor (1d4) until the end of its next turn.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Circlet of Valor requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from a Fiend
**[Dust]**: Any Dust
**[Hide]**: Plates from a Construct
**[Organ]**: Glands from a Dragon

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Brutal
description.value: A Brutal weapon is designed for maximum damage. Brutal weapons score Critical Hits on a natural roll of 19 or 20. If your Critical Range is already increased, instead increase it by 1 point (such as from 19-20 to 18-20).
When you score a Critical Hit with a Brutal weapon against a creature, the weapon deals one additional die of damage.
(Requires the __Mark of Passage__)
This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast __Dimension Door__ as a Magic action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is Lightly Obscured by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

name: Cloak of Shadows
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: While you wear this cloak, Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made to perceive you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks.

This is a cloak made of ears that were once part of a swarm of ears. It pulses gently and oozes yellow fluid from its many holes. While wearing this cloak, you can take an action to create one of two effects:

**Ooze**: You tug the cloak to create a puddle of waxy goo that covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within 30 feet of you. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the area must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or have the Grappled condition (escape DC 15). This wax remains for 1 minute. Once this effect is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

**Hide**: You completely conceal your head with the cloak. You have the Blinded condition, you have Blindsight with a range of 120 feet, and you can hear all speech within 120 feet regardless of obstructions. These effects last for 1 minute.
Once this effect is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.
This fine garment is made of mausgeist fur with a silk lining. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits:
**Heightened Senses**: You have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing.
**Magic Protection**: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
**Charm**: You can take an action to cast the __Charm Person__ spell (save DC 13). Once used, this property of the cloak can't be used again until the next dawn.
This cloak is made from stygian bat hides and bristles with coarse black hair. While wearing the cloak, you have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on hearing.

In addition, you can take an action to gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet for one minute. While this effect is active, you also have blindsight with a range of 120 feet, and you have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws while in the air. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
This spotted grey cloak is made of styrkvisnar hide. While wearing it, you have Advantage on Strength (*Athletics*) checks.

Additionally, you can take an action to transform into a wolf, eagle, or seal for up to 1 hour. The transformation otherwise functions as the __Polymorph__ spell, but you can take a Bonus Action to revert to your normal form. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
This coat is made from the tongues of a harvester of lies' victims. While you wear it, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and you have Advantage on Charisma (*Deception*) checks.

The cloak has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. You can use a Bonus Action and expend 1 charge while wearing the cloak to enhance the next spell you cast before the start of your next turn, allowing that spell to be cast without any Verbal or Somatic components.

This armor is a creation of the daelkyr Belashyrra, the Lord of Eyes. Made from a tough, leathery material, the coat is warm to the touch and covered with eyes—eyes of many different types of creatures, constantly glancing around as it studies your surroundings. When you attune to the armor, it binds itself to your flesh and shares its insight, granting the following benefits:

entries: **Darkvision**: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
**Eyes Everywhere**: The armor lets you see in all directions, and you have advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight.

**Gifts of the All-Seer**: All Coats of Many Eyes are linked to Belashyrra, and while wearing one you may receive visions—flashes of things the Lord of Eyes wishes to see through you. If you follow through with these tasks, your armor can evolve, gaining additional powers and increasing its effective rarity.
**Rare**: A rare coat also grants you a +1 bonus to AC and allows you to see Invisible creatures and objects within 120 feet.
**Symbiotic Nature**: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

description.value: This Gold Piece appears mundane but, when flipped, always lands on the side you call while it is in the air. Additionally, you can summon it to your palm at will as a Bonus Action.
This dark metal coin is a token of heretical dogma that claims Empyreus and Beleth are one and the same. One side bears the Empyreus's icon, while the other shows Beleth's leering face.

While holding this coin, you can take an action to flip it. Roll a d6. The icon of Empyreus shows on an even number, granting you the Boon of Empyreus. On an odd number, Beleth shows and confers the Boon of Beleth.

**Boon of Empyreus**: For one minute, you gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class, and you add 1d4 to the first attack roll you make each of your turns. If you would receive this boon again before the next dawn, you instead take **3d6** Radiant damage and the boon is not applied.

**Boon of Beleth**: For one minute, an aura radiates from you in a 10-foot radius. When an enemy ends its turn in the area, it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or have the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. While the aura lasts, you deal an extra **1d6** Psychic damage whenever you hit a Frightened creature with a weapon attack. If you would receive this boon again before the next dawn, you instead take **3d6** Necrotic damage and the boon is not applied.

This icy circlet is made from frozen contaminated ichor, kept in a state of permafrost by the heart of a naturally cold creature, and lined with frozen bones of undead, all powered by the animus of an elemental. Even in its permanently frozen state, it is comfortable to wear.

Once per turn, when you cast a spell that deals Cold damage using a spell slot, you can choose one target that was dealt Cold damage by the spell to gain the Frozen condition. The escape DC equals your spell save DC.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Cold Snap Circlet requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from an Elemental
**[Bones]**: Ribs from an Undead
**[Fluid]**: Contaminated Ichor
**[Organ]**: Heart from a White Dragon, Silver Dragon, Winter Troll, or any monster Immune to Cold damage.

description.value: This infamous axe is wielded by the memori lich known as Runa Banasár. It appears to be made of ice, carved with runes and studded with various tiny, glittering gems.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a hit, the weapon deals an extra **4d6** Cold damage. If a single attack with Coldrazor deals more than 20 points of Cold damage, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Stunned condition until the end of its next turn.
Immediately after hitting or missing with a ranged attack made with this weapon, it flies back to your hand.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

Some people have no qualms about exploiting any opportunity for profit, including the sorrow caused by the loss of a loved one. Such people would appreciate the Collar of the Undead, whether as con artists looking for bereaved individuals to fleece, or as dark sorcerers in need of souls.

As an action, you can place this collar around the neck of a Humanoid creature of Large size or smaller that has died within the last 10 days. The creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point. The creature uses its normal game statistics, except that its creature type becomes Undead and it doesn't need to eat, sleep, or breathe. If its Hit Points are reduced to 0, the creature is utterly destroyed, turning into dust.

Each dawn, the creature's Hit Point Maximum decreases by 1d4 as its soul slowly slips away. When the creature's Hit Point Maximum reaches 0, or its Hit Points are reduced to 0, it falls apart into a heap of dust and is destroyed.

On each of your turns, you can take a Bonus Action to mentally command the creature if it is within 60 feet of you, and it follows your orders to the best of your ability. If you issue no commands, the creature takes the Dodge action and moves only to avoid harm. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.
If the collar is removed, the creature is immediately reduced to 0 Hit Points.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

Crafted by the daelkyr, this gauntlet appears to be the forearm of a monstrous humanoid. When you attune to it, it surrounds your hand and forearm, fusing to your flesh.

When you make an Unarmed Strike, you can slash with the talons on the gauntlet. On a hit, you can deal Slashing damage equal to **1d6** + your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. Additionally, you can project an ectoplasmic duplicate of the gauntlet, allowing you to manipulate objects at a distance. While wearing this gauntlet, you can take a Magic action to cast __Mage Hand__ from it.

This crest is crafted from the compressed dust of fiends destroyed and sanctified by the Sacred Flame and torched in fires ignited by the elemental fluid taken from a dragon. This simple crest is made from the bones of undead creatures washed in acidic monster bile.
While attuned to this magic crest you increase the Emanation of your Aura of Protection by 10 feet.

description.value: This tiny bottle contains a cocktail of pheromones from creatures of prey. As an action, you spray the pheromones on one target within 5 feet, and its effect lasts for 1 minute.
Beasts or other creatures that must attack the nearest creature will target the affected individual instead, as long as that individual is within 60 feet of the attacker.

name: Crown of the Barrow King (Legendary)

description.value: This crown of twisted iron has five sharp, tall spikes that are crusted with dried blood. None who see it doubt the malice and corruption that the Barrow King imbued into it.

While you wear the crown, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the crown's rarity to spell attack rolls and to your spell save DC for Necromancy spells and spells that deal Necrotic damage, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Demand of the Dead (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Speak with Dead__ from the crown.

description.name: Grave Grasp (Rare+)
description.value: You know the __Chill Touch__ cantrip. Your spell attack bonus with it is +9 (Rare), +10 (Very Rare), or +11 (Legendary).

description.name: Necromancer's Call (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Animate Dead__ from the crown. It can be used to cast this spell three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Master of Undeath (Very Rare+)
description.value: Undead that you create or summon have twice as many Hit Points as normal and have Advantage on saving throws.

description.name: Soul Transfer (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you drop to 0 Hit Points or fail a Death Saving Throw, you can transfer your soul into an Undead that you created and that is within 1 mile of you (no action required). Your previous body dies instantly. Your new body has none of your possessions except the crown. You use your game statistics, except the target Undead's current Hit Points replace your current Hit Points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Compel Undead (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can choose an Undead within 30 feet of you. It must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw or have the Charmed condition for 1 minute. It obeys your commands while Charmed in this way, and the condition ends early when the creature is *Bloodied*.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: This platinum crown is adorned with black gems and shells. While you wear the crown, you have Resistance to Cold damage and can breathe underwater. Also, your Constitution is 20 while you wear the crown, unless it is 20 or higher without it.

description.name: Curse
description.value: This crown is cursed, a fact revealed only when an __Identify__ spell is cast on the crown or you attune to it. Attuning to the crown curses you until you are targeted by the __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic; it is impossible to remove the crown. While cursed, you turn into a keppmir after 2d10 days.

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.
A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

description.name: Delerium Properties
description.value: All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

entries: Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.

Unless contained within an __Antimagic Field__, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points. However, delerium geodes release a random [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) when destroyed.

description.name: Delerium Hazards
description.value: When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

description.name: Delerium Harvesting
description.value: Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

description.name: Uses for Delerium
description.value: Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

description.name: Spell Component
description.value: Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

description.name: Magic Items
description.value: Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

description.name: Stable Delerium
description.value: The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

description.name: Delerium Dust
description.value: Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an __Antimagic Field__. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Cutlass of Briggsy Kratch (Legendary)

description.value: A fearsome weapon imbued with jinxcraft magic, this cutlass was once wielded by the notorious pirate captain, Briggsy "The Kutlass" Kratch. Its tarnished blade glimmers with a faint, otherworldly light. A skull and crossbones adorn the leather-wrapped hilt, and arcane symbols etched into the blade pulse with hidden power.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with the cutlass determined by its rarity. While holding the cutlass, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Raise the Stakes (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, choose a creature within 5 feet of you and mark it until the start of your next turn. Count the number of times you hit the target and the number of times it hits you while the mark lasts. If you hit the target more times, it takes **2d10** Psychic damage. If it hits you more times, you take **2d10** Psychic damage. If your hits are tied, you both take **2d10** Psychic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sea Legs (Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Disengage action, Difficult Terrain doesn't cost you extra movement until the end of that turn.

description.name: Double Down (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can make one additional attack against a target marked by the Raise the Stakes property.

description.name: Jinxcraft Panache (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature hits you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to increase your AC against that attack by twice the cutlass's bonus to attack and damage rolls if the creature already dealt damage to you on this turn.

description.name: Hex Ward (Legendary)
description.value: You can't be targeted with Divination spells or perceived through magical scrying sensors, and a creature that curses you takes Psychic damage equal to your level.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

description.value: Few ever saw the gleaming blade Dämglesvir before the Gods' End, as only the emperor was permitted to draw the sword from its sheath. Now its blade and hilt are black, like a weapon dipped in shadow.

description.name: Aspirant
description.value: At this tier of Attunement, you have the following benefits:

entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with Dämglesvir.
Any weapon you wield deals an extra **1d6** Force damage.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: You become pallid and of ill health. You have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.

description.name: Adept
description.value: At the Adept tier of Attunement, you have the following additional benefits:

entries: A creature that takes damage from the sword can't regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

When you take the Attack action, you may declare one of your attacks with the sword as a sweeping strike. Instead of a single attack, make an attack with the sword against each creature of your choice within reach. You can use this sweeping strike a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: Drawing on the power of the sword takes a physical toll on your body. When you hit a creature with the sword, your Hit Point maximum is reduced by 1. This reduction lasts until you finish a Long Rest.

description.value: (Requires the __Mark of Sentinel__)
While holding this Shield, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and Wisdom (*Perception*) checks. The Shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.

name: Detection Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Detection__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Detection__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Detection Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Detection__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Detection__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Detection Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Detection__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Detection__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Devilbone Button

description.value: This bone button is found on an article of clothing, such as a shirt or coat, and is carved with the tiny image of a devil. It must be attached to clothing that you wear to attune to it. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws, and it has the following properties.

description.name: Improbable Luck
description.value: When you fail a saving throw while wearing the button, you can choose to succeed instead. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Protective Bone
description.value: While wearing the button, your Hit Point maximum increases by 5 + your Constitution modifier.

description.name: Diabolic Curse
description.value: When you finish a Long Rest, there is a 1 percent chance the button is mysteriously missing and your Attunement to it ends. A devil with a CR of your level + 3 or CR 20 (whichever is lower) then becomes your enemy and seeks to destroy you. The GM determines the devil's details. When you use the Improbable Luck property, the chance the button disappears increases by 1.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

name: Double Blade

description.name: Double
description.value: A Double weapon functions as two Light weapons, one in each hand, for the purposes of two-weapon fighting. If a Double weapon has Reach, you can use only one of these properties per turn.

description.name: Momentum
description.value: Momentum weapons allow you to deliver devastating attacks as part of rapid movement. When you hit with a Momentum weapon after you moved 20 feet or more in a straight line during the same turn, upgrade the damage dice to the weapon's Momentum Dice value.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Set
description.value: Weapons with the Set property allow you to prepare for an oncoming attack. If a target enters your reach while you wield a weapon with this property, you can use your Reaction to make a melee attack with the weapon against that target.

name: Double-Barrel Shotgun

description.value: A classic design with two loaded barrels, the Double-Barrel Shotgun trades ammo capacity and range for reliability and firepower.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Recoil
description.value: After you make an attack with this weapon, you can't make ranged attacks beyond the weapon's normal range until the end of the current turn.

description.name: Reload
description.value: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a Bonus Action.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Scatter
description.value: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with this weapon.

description.name: Blackpowder
description.value: Blackpowder weapons fire projectiles with ear-splitting noise, shredding armor with deadly force. When fired, Blackpowder weapons emit a deafening crack audible 300 feet away. A Blackpowder weapon exposed to heavy rain, submerged, or similarly drenched in water, can't fire until dried for 1 hour. These weapons use paper cartridge bullets as ammunition.

description.name: Loading
description.value: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

description.name: Scatter
description.value: Scatter weapons can devastate multiple enemies at once. When you take the Attack action and hit a creature with a Scatter weapon, measure the weapon's scatter range from the target's space (or one square the creature occupies if it is Large or larger). Creatures other than the original target that fall within the weapon's scatter range take damage equal to your 1 + your Dexterity modifier (minimum 2). This damage is of the same type you dealt to the original target.

description.value: When you drink this potion, you gain a ravenous thirst for blood and gain the effect of the __Vampiric Touch__ spell (level 6 version, no *Concentration* required) for 1 minute. You can repeat the attack on subsequent turns as a Bonus Action instead of a Magic action.
This liquid is a shimmering red deeper and more intense than natural blood.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For the duration, as a Magic action, you can gain the effects of the __Gaseous Form__ spell (no *Concentration* required) while you aren't in sunlight. You can also revert to your normal form as a Magic action.

Made from a mysterious, magically grown plant, this popular new drug induces vivid hallucinations in which the user's dreams appear to be fulfilled. Some users even see visions of branching possibilities that their life could take.
Upon consuming Dreams Leaves, you can choose to fall into a blissful, trance-like state for 1 hour, during which time you have the Unconscious condition. Taking damage ends the trance early.

If you remain in the trance for the full hour, you awaken with a faint insight into your future. Once before you finish your next Long Rest, you can take a Reaction to reroll a D20 Test and use the new result.

Using this Reaction creates an addiction to Dreams Leaves. While addicted, you have Disadvantage on saving throws. Consuming another dose of Dreams Leaves negates this effect until you finish a Long Rest.
The addiction lasts until you receive a __Greater Restoration__ spell, or until you have not consumed Dreams Leaves for 30 days.

While holding or wearing this item, you can take a Magic action to summon or dismiss a dome of energy that manifests just above your head. This energy repels moderate quantities of frozen and liquid water, such as rain, snow, bird droppings, or other similar nuisances, but can't be used to protect against harsh environmental hazards or attacks. The energy field is typically silvery and translucent. More expensive models have illusions woven into the field; one popular version creates the image of a sunny blue sky overhead.

While holding this wand, you can take a Magic action to instantly clean an area within 10 feet of you that is no larger than 1 cubic foot, removing dirt and grime. There are many variations of the Duster; the two-handed Staff of Cleansing covers a five-foot cube with a single Magic action, while the Bright Basin cleans clothing and cloth objects placed within it.

This weapon is made of silver spirit energy that phases in and out of reality, making it extremely difficult for living creatures to perceive. You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Attack rolls made with the whip against non-Undead creatures have Advantage.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

This ring, composed of living lightning, is forged from elemental dust compressed into a gem around the lens eye of a construct, washed in the acidic glands of a monster before being set into an animus of an elemental.

When you cast a spell using a spell slot that deals Lightning damage, choose one target that failed its first saving throw against that spell. That creature is Shocked until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating an Electric Charge Ring requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from an Elemental
**[Dust]**: Elemental Dust
**[Organ]**: Eye from a Construct
**[Organ]**: Glands

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Swift
description.value: Swift weapons help you recover quickly from missed attacks. When you miss with a Swift weapon, you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with the weapon against the same target before the end of your next turn. If that attack hits, it also deals an extra **1d4** damage of the weapon's normal damage type.

This foul-smelling liquid is made from the saliva of an elemental troll. For one minute after consuming the potion, you can take a Bonus Action to spit energy at a creature within 5 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw or take **2d6** damage of a type corresponding to the troll whose spittle was used to craft the potion. No damage is inflicted on a successful save.
If the target rolls a natural 20 on its saving throw, the potion explodes inside you. You take **6d6** damage of the type listed for it, and the potion's duration ends immediately.

When you drink this potion, your breath billows out in clouds of fog. For the next 10 minutes, fog and smoke don't hinder your vision, you can cast __Fog Cloud__ up to three times (no *Concentration* required), and you can cast __Misty Step__ up to three times as long as your teleportation begins or ends in an area of fog. This bottle has a base like cobblestone. The glass widens near the top before narrowing again into an iron cap, resembling a lantern. The liquid inside is a murky gray.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: The potion's duration becomes 1 hour, and when you use this potion to cast __Misty Step__, you also gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the start of your next turn.
After you drink this thick, chalky mixture, your Hit Point maximum cannot be reduced for 10 minutes.
This magical feather can sometimes be found growing from a rabenhex. While holding the feather, you can take an action to cast __Remove Curse__. Afterward, the feather becomes nonmagical.

This large ceramic stein is decorated with dwarven glyphs and topped with a brass lid that can be opened by thumb lever. While the lid is closed and the stein is empty, you can name a nonmagical ale, beer, or mead as a Bonus Action and the stein fills with that liquid.

This cauldron is made using the plated iron from a construct infused with the ash of an elemental. The animus used must be from a dragon which adds both control and potency to the latent elemental magics. The spoon used to stir the cauldron is carved from the bone of a magical creature. This cauldron can heat to boiling temperatures without requiring fire simply by being filled and stirred, and the stews and soups it produces are always delicious and hearty.

During a Long Rest, you can cook enough stew to feed up to three creatures. All creatures who eat a stew from this pot gain 10 Temporary Hit Points. While a creature has these Temporary Hit Points, they gain Valor (1d4).

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating an Everhot Stew Pot requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from a Dragon
**[Bones]**: Ribs from a Monstrosity
**[Dust]**: Elemental Dust
**[Hide]**: Plates

name: Eye of the White Worm (Legendary)

description.value: This fist-sized eyeball is cold and clammy to the touch. It is milky-white with purple veins, and its pupil constantly searches for something.

While holding the eye, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the eye's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Thought Scour (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Detect Thoughts__ (save DC = 16 + the eye's bonus) from the eye. When you probe deeper into a creature's mind, it takes **3d8** Psychic damage unless it is a willing target. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Mnemonic Siphon (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Modify Memory__ (save DC = 16 + the eye's bonus) from the eye. When you do, you gain a version of the affected memory as if you experienced it yourself, though you still know the memory isn't yours. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Violation of the Real (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you cast a Conjuration spell using a spell slot that deals damage, or that summons a creature that can deal damage, the spell or creature deals an extra **1d10** Psychic damage to one target the first time it deals damage during a turn.

description.name: Enduring Violation (Legendary)
description.value: When you cast a Conjuration spell with a duration of 1 hour or more, you can extend the duration to 24 hours, and the spell no longer requires *Concentration*. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: (Requires the __Mark of Finding__)

These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.
This crown is woven of aromatic flowers. When you first don the crown after attuning to it, 1d6 + 3 butterflies begin fluttering around it.
When you are hit by a melee attack, you can take a Reaction to release one of the butterflies. The attack misses you and destroys the butterfly instead.
Once all butterflies are destroyed, the crown withers and crumbles to dust.
Once per day as a Magic action, you can use this finely-carved figurine to cast __Find Familiar__.

description.value: Legend has it these hand claws were crafted from the talons of a fabled feline. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

description.name: Darkvision
description.value: While you are holding this magic weapon, you have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

description.name: Feline Form
description.value: While you are holding this magic weapon, you can cast __Polymorph__ from it. When you do, the spell targets only yourself and the only form you can take is a Cat.

description.name: Nine Lives
description.value: The weapon has 9 charges. While holding it, when you fail a Death Saving Throw you can expend 1 charge (no action required) to succeed on it instead. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

description.name: Disarming
description.value: A Disarming weapon can catch a foe's weapon, allowing you to remove it from their grasp. When you take the Attack action on your turn and hit with a Disarming weapon, you can use your Bonus Action later on the same turn to disarm the target. Both you and the attacker must make opposed attack rolls, ignoring any sources of Advantage and Disadvantage. If your result is higher and the weapon is something the target can drop, the weapon falls from the target's grasp, landing in its space.

If your winning result on the opposed attack roll was a Critical Hit, you can choose for the weapon either to land in a space of your choice up to 15 feet from the target, or to land in your hand if you have a free hand.

description.value: This tendril of flesh, harvested from an Aberration, melds with the body of its host. If you are a Humanoid, you can attune to this item by stitching it into your skin during the Attunement process. At the end of this time, the fin burrows into your body and bonds with your muscular system. Non-Humanoids cannot attune to the Fin Symbiote.
While attuned to the symbiote, you gain the following benefits:
**Symbiotic Health**: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws.
**Immovable**: When you would be moved against your will, you can take a Reaction to subtract 10 feet from that movement.
**Aberrant Power**: If you have achieved at least Stage 1 of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, add +2 to the DC of save DCs for your Aberrant Horror Boons.

**Symbiote Link**: You cannot voluntarily end your Attunement to this magic item. If it is physically removed from your body, it regrows in 1d4 hours unless you receive a __Remove Curse__ spell before it grows back (which also ends your Attunement).
(Requires Use by a Warforged)

A delicate winged creature, this homunculus was designed to facilitate communication between warforged soldiers during the Last War. A __Final Messenger__ is a Tiny Construct with an AC of 20, 6 Hit Points, and a Fly Speed of 60 feet. It has Immunity to Poison damage and Psychic damage, and all conditions other than Unconscious. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, treat all its ability scores as 10 (+0). It has Darkvision with a range of 60 feet. It has no limbs and the only action it can take on its turn is the Dash action.

If you are a warforged, you can take a Magic action to integrate a Final Messenger into your body. While it is part of your body, the messenger cannot be targeted by any attack. You can only have one messenger attached to your body at a time. A messenger can only remain active for 8 hours after it detaches from a warforged body, after which time its energy dissipates and it gains the Unconscious condition. An Unconscious messenger must complete a Short or Long Rest while attached to a warforged, after which it regains its energy, as well as regaining all lost Hit Points.

A Final Messenger holds four pieces of data, accessible only to the warforged it is attached to. While the messenger is attached to you, you can take a Magic action to review the data currently stored within the messenger, and if you choose to, change any or all of these data points.

entries: A destination for the messenger. This can be very specific (a particular apartment in Sharn) or more general (an open marketplace).
A target individual. This could be a specific person or a category ("Any Karrnathi warforged").
A single image recorded through the eyes of a warforged attached to the messenger.
A message of up to 25 words.

description.value: You can release the messenger as a Bonus Action, at which point it flies to its destination by the most direct route possible. Once it reaches the destination it seeks the target individual; if no target has been set, it approaches the nearest warforged.

If you are reduced to 0 Hit Points while a Final Messenger is attached to you, it immediately detaches and seeks out its target. It retains its stored message, but replaces its stored image with the last thing you saw before dropping to 0 Hit Points.

name: Finding Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Finding__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Finding__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Finding Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Finding__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Finding__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Finding Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Finding__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Finding__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

entries: **Ability**: Intelligence
**Utilize**: Reveal the fingerprint left behind on an object and sketch a copy (DC 20), or match a copied fingerprint against a humanoid creature's (DC 15).

description.value: This item allows you to capture the details of a fingerprint that has been left on an object and match them against another creature. It consists of an inkpad, parchment, and talcum powder.

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

You can throw a Fire Bomb by using an Attack action. Target one space you can see within 20 feet. A creature in this space must make on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature in that space takes **2d6** Slashing damage and **4d6** Fire damage and starts Burning. Creatures adjacent to the attacked space take half that damage and are not Burning.

name: Flame Bellows

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Cumbersome
description.value: Cumbersome weapons are difficult to wield but are effective ranged tools for those strong enough to wield them. When making an attack with a Cumbersome weapon, you must use your Strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

description.name: Loading
description.value: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

description.name: Magazine
description.value: A weapon with the Magazine property also has a number and an ammunition type. The weapon holds that amount and type of ammunition, which you can expend before needing to reload the weapon. As a Bonus Action, you may remove a Magazine and then reload it with a new Magazine. A Magazine weapon comes with two empty magazines included in the weapon's cost and weight. An additional empty magazine for a Magazine weapon costs 25 GP. Loading an empty Magazine with ammunition takes 1 minute.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Scatter
description.value: Scatter weapons can devastate multiple enemies at once. When you take the Attack action and hit a creature with a Scatter weapon, measure the weapon's scatter range from the target's space (or one square the creature occupies if it is Large or larger). Creatures other than the original target that fall within the weapon's scatter range take damage equal to your 1 + your Dexterity modifier (minimum 2). This damage is of the same type you dealt to the original target.

properties: cumbersome weapons are difficult to wield but are effective ranged tools for those strong enough to wield them. when making an attack with a cumbersome weapon, you must use your strength modifier for the attack and damage rolls.

description.value: This swirling mixture of red and white liquid is formed from the remains of a coldfire ooze. As an action, the vial of Flammable Tincture can be hurled up to 30 feet at a target, which must succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or be covered with the liquid. For 1 minute, the creature loses its Immunity or Resistance to Fire damage and has Vulnerability to Fire damage instead.
Ammunition is required by a weapon that has Ammunition. A weapon's description specifies the type of ammunition used by the weapon.
Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

name: Flare Gun

description.value: Less a firearm and more a survival tool, a Flare Gun fires a single white-hot flare, useful for distress signals and last-ditch-effort self defense.

description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.value: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: As an action, a creature in a Thin Place can create a gate to the Ethereal Plane for 1 minute, after which the key crumbles to dust

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating the Fractal Key requires a Rare forge and the following components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from a __Fractal Lepidoptera__
**[Bones]**: Bones of any Rare creature

description.value: Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.
A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

description.name: Delerium Properties
description.value: All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

entries: Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.

Unless contained within an __Antimagic Field__, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points. However, delerium geodes release a random [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) when destroyed.

description.name: Delerium Hazards
description.value: When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

description.name: Delerium Harvesting
description.value: Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

description.name: Uses for Delerium
description.value: Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

description.name: Spell Component
description.value: Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

description.name: Magic Items
description.value: Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

description.name: Stable Delerium
description.value: The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

description.name: Delerium Dust
description.value: Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an __Antimagic Field__. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

While holding this clay statuette of a frog, you can speak its command word and kiss it to cast the spell __Mandy's Feral Follower__, transforming the statuette into a __Commoner__. The commoner created by the statuette retains the memories of each time it is transformed, no matter what appearance you ascribe to it.
Once it has been used, the statuette can't transform again until the next dawn.

This potent powder is supposedly created by grinding up the dried organs of a werewolf. Despite the risks associated with its use, it is a favored drug of many wrestlers, boxers, and soldiers because of the raw strength it provides.

Consuming this potion enhances your physical prowess for 1 hour. While the effect lasts, your Strength score becomes 19 (unless it was already 19 or higher), and you have Advantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws.

Prolonged use of Full Moon Extract is risky. You can consume it safely a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1). Any further use results in painful addiction. While addicted, you have Disadvantage on Dexterity ability checks and saving throws, and attack rolls against you have Advantage.

Consuming another dose of Full Moon Extract negates this effect until you finish a Long Rest, but you must also make a DC 10 Charisma save. On a failure, you become overcome by violent urges for 1 minute. During that time, you cannot take Bonus Actions or Reactions. At the start of each of your turns, you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear as your enemy. During that turn, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the Attack action, targeting the creature. If your movement doesn't bring you within reach, you must use your Dash action to continue moving toward it.
The addiction lasts until you receive a __Greater Restoration__ spell, or until you have not consumed Full Moon Extract for 30 days.

This delicate mask is made of thinly beaten copper that molds to the skin when worn. While wearing this mask, you can use an action to alter your appearance, including your height, weight, facial features, the sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics for 8 hours. You can make yourself appear as a member of another species, though none of your statistics change. You also can't appear as a creature of a different size, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this item to become quadrupedal, for instance.
Creatures within 5 feet of you can use an action to make a DC 20 Intelligence (*Investigation*) check to discern your true appearance.
If you have reached at least Stage 1 of the Lich Transformation, you also gain a +2 bonus to Armor Class while your appearance is disguised by the mask.
Once you use the mask, you cannot do so again until the following dawn.

name: Gatling Gun

description.value: Infamous for its rate of fire, the Gatling Gun rotates and fires six or more barrels in succession. This weapon is cumbersome, easily recognizable, and utterly terrifying.

description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Reload
description.value: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a Bonus Action.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Automatic
description.value: When you make an attack with this weapon, you can choose to make two attacks instead. These attacks are always made with Disadvantage, regardless of circumstance. You can't replace these attacks. If this weapon has Ammunition, these attacks use twice the normal amount of ammunition.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.
