description.value: The Pnakotic Manuscripts originate from a long-lost species that once walked the world, long before the rise of humans, elves, and other intelligences. These creatures communed with the Cthulhu Mythos and were perhaps their servitors. This strange tome was written before time began its proper flow and grants insights into its workings. By reading it, you learn to move between time's beats.

description.name: Language:
description.value: Primordial (XPHB).

description.name: Attunement Check:
description.value: Intelligence (*Religion*) DC 15. To end your Attunement to the Pnakotic Manuscripts, you must be the target of a __Remove Curse__ spell.

description.name: Benefits:
description.value: While attuned to the Pnakotic Manuscripts, you gain the following benefits:

entries: You double your bonus to Initiative.
You gain a +10 bonus to Speed.
You have Advantage on all Dexterity saving throws.
You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
Once per turn while moving, you can teleport back to any spot you occupied during your current move.

description.name: Drawbacks:
description.value: You age at an accelerated rate. After one week, you age an additional week. After two weeks, you age an additional four weeks. After three weeks, you age an additional six weeks, and so on. If you remove your Attunement to this item and later attune to it again, you preserve this drawback's progress.

description.name: Insight-No Time to Tarry (+15):
description.value: You hate any activity that takes more than a few moments. You grow impatient as your attention fades and you seek something new to do, leaving critical work unattended as you start a new project or seek out something new to do.

description.name: Lore:
description.value: The Pnakotic Manuscript allows you to automatically succeed all checks made to learn about time and its nature.

name: Polearm

description.name: Hafted
description.value: A Hafted weapon's haft can function well as an off-hand attack. After you use the Attack action to attack with a Hafted weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the haft. The haft deals **1d6** Bludgeoning damage, and you add your ability modifier to damage.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Set
description.value: Weapons with the Set property allow you to prepare for an oncoming attack. If a target enters your reach while you wield a weapon with this property, you can use your Reaction to make a melee attack with the weapon against that target.

properties: a hafted weapon's haft can function well as an off-hand attack. after you use the attack action to attack with a hafted weapon, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the haft. the haft deals **1d6** bludgeoning damage, and you add your ability modifier to damage.

description.value: This bag contains twenty iron balls, each measuring one inch in diameter and weighing 1/4 of a pound. When poured out of their bag as a Utilize action, the balls function as Ball Bearings.

As a Bonus Action, you can speak the command word, which causes a number of the balls that you choose to expand into full-size cannonballs weighing 10 pounds each, suitable for firing from a cannon. A creature in the path of one or more cannonballs rolling downhill must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw or take **2d10** Bludgeoning damage and have the Prone condition if it is Large or smaller.

Each iron ball can also be used as a Sling Bullet or a Firearm Bullet. As a Bonus Action when you make an attack with an iron ball as ammunition, you can expand it in midair. On a hit, this attack deals Bludgeoning damage equal to 2d12 plus the ability modifier used for the attack roll instead of the weapon's normal damage.

This sickly-looking potion contains a writhing mass of tentacles that animate and uncomfortably crawl down the imbiber's throat when consumed. The taste is pungent and fishy, and results in the sudden outbreak of random, but temporary, mutations.

When you consume this potion, you gain the effects of one randomly determined Mutation until you start a Short or Long Rest. You can roll on the [Mutations](https://5e.tools/tables.html#mutations_monstersofdrakkenheim) table twice, choosing which mutation manifests. You don't gain any Contamination levels as a result of this Mutation. When the effect ends, your body returns to normal.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Potion of Controlled Mutation requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from an Aberration
**[Fluid]**: Contaminated Ichor
**[Organs]**: Any two Organs from an Aberration

description.value: This brew is made from the ground horns of keppmirs. When consumed, this potion allows you to breathe underwater for 1 hour, during which time you have Resistance to Cold damage. It tastes salty and gives off a slight warmth.
This concoction is the result of a failed attempt to make a Potion of Heal. It is indistinguishable from that potion without using divination magic of level 3 or higher.

When you imbibe this potion, roll 1d4. That becomes your new Hit Point total. If the Potion of Harm is given to a creature with 0 Hit Points, they instantly suffer a Death Saving Throw failure and begin dying if they are Stable.
This ebon liquid is made from the remains of a downcast vampire. When you imbibe this potion, you regain all your Hit Points.

This shimmering liquid changes colors constantly within its vial. Made from the acid glands of the dreaded wolfentroika, this potion allows you to share your life force with others. After drinking this potion, you can take a Bonus Action to choose a creature within 30 feet of you that you can see or hear. That creature regains 4d6 Hit Points, and you take an equal amount of Necrotic damage, which can't be reduced or prevented in any way. The effect ends after 1 minute, at which point you gain 1 level of Exhaustion.

This brew is made from the spore sacs of three grippers. When consumed, this potion causes the imbiber to give off spores that anger enemies within 10 feet. Those enemies must succeed on a DC 10 Wisdom saving throw, or they must target the imbiber with their attacks for 1 minute. All weapon attacks are made with Disadvantage.

This viscous potion is made from quoxxarie blood. After drinking this potion, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points you can expend a Hit Point Dice (no action required) and set your Hit Points to 1. This effect lasts for 1 minute, at the end of which you must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of Exhaustion for each Hit Die spent during the potion's duration.
For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with your Unarmed Strikes.
This potion is thick and dark brown topped with a cream colored froth.

This charm is a charred feather harvested from a fallen angel, wrapped in silver wire. While you wear this charm, your creature type appears to be Humanoid for the purpose of __Detect Evil and Good__ and similar effects.

name: Prospector's Wand
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Finding__)

description.value: This Y-shaped wand, bearing the emblem of the __Mark of Finding__, has 5 charges. While holding the wand, you can use any of its properties:

description.name: Finding
description.value: You can expend 2 charges to cast __Locate Creature__ from it.

description.name: Location
description.value: You can expend 1 charge to cast __Locate Object__ from it.

description.name: Prospecting
description.value: You can expend 1 charge to cast __Locate Animals or Plants__ from it, with the following benefits.
You can describe or name a specific kind of mineral and locate it instead of a Beast or Plant.

You can specify the minimum quantity of that Beast, Plant, or mineral that you wish the spell to find within a 30-foot-radius sphere, such as "at least 3 pounds of Eberron dragonshards" or "at least five deer." You learn the direction and distance to the closest occurrence in that *Concentration*, if any are present.

description.name: Regaining Charges
description.value: The wand regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

The brutal warfare and vicious monsters prevalent across Etharis leave many with Grievous Wounds, including missing limbs and other potentially debilitating injuries. The engineers and crafters of the world have made great strides in helping those people deal with those injuries through Prosthetics.
When a creature with a Grievous Wound uses a Prosthetic, they ignore the penalties imposed by the Grievous Wound while wearing a Prosthetic that replaces the lost or wounded body part.
Some Prosthetics can be enchanted with magic, giving them even further powers. Rules for Magical Prosthetics can be found in the *Grim Hollow Campaign Guide*.

name: Pump Shotgun

description.value: The Pump Shotgun's namesake is a distinctive sliding grip on the barrel which can be "pumped" to chamber a new round.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Recoil
description.value: After you make an attack with this weapon, you can't make ranged attacks beyond the weapon's normal range until the end of the current turn.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Reload
description.value: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a Bonus Action.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Scatter
description.value: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with this weapon.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.
after you make an attack with this weapon, you can't make ranged attacks beyond the weapon's normal range until the end of the current turn.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Punching Dagger

description.name: Armor-Piercing
description.value: An Armor-Piercing weapon is a Melee weapon designed to punch through armor or thick hide. When you make an attack roll using an Armor-Piercing weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll if your target is wearing armor or has an Armor Class of 18 or higher.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Defending
description.value: A Defending weapon is either made for parrying, has advanced techniques for use in parrying, or both. When wielding a Defending weapon, you may use your Reaction when you are hit by a melee attack roll. Roll 1d4 and add the result to your AC, including against the triggering attack.

properties: an armor-piercing weapon is a melee weapon designed to punch through armor or thick hide. when you make an attack roll using an armor-piercing weapon, you gain a +1 bonus to the attack roll if your target is wearing armor or has an armor class of 18 or higher.

description.value: Fashioned from the scales of a quake drake, this armor rumbles softly with the sound of thunder during storms. While wearing it, you have Resistance to Thunder damage.

description.name: Stealth Disadvantage
description.value: The wearer has **Disadvantage** on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

This humble acorn is one of the mightiest gifts a Faerie queen can bestow upon her subjects. While holding the acorn, you can cast the __Wish__ spell. After using the acorn in this way, it immediately teleports back to the queen who bestowed it.

If the __Wish__ spell is used in a way that the queen would perceive as a threat to herself or her realm, the spell does not work. Instead, the creature who made the wish immediately transforms into an oak tree. Only a __Wish__ spell cast with the Queen's Token can return a creature transformed in this way to its original state.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest, choose one of the following damage types: Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. The first time each turn that you hit a target with a weapon attack using ammunition drawn from this quiver, the attack deals an extra **1d6** damage of the chosen type.
This punch knife style weapon is carved from a single chunk of superconductive dark violet metal that binds to the fist and forearm with black leather straps.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you score a Critical Hit against a creature with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra **2d6** Lightning damage. Additionally, while you are attuned to this magical weapon, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls and you can cast __Jump__ on yourself.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

When you hit with an attack as part of an Attack action using this magic dagger and apply your Sneak Attack to the damage roll, you can make an additional attack using this dagger as part of the same action. If that attack hits and meets the criteria for your Sneak Attack, you can apply half your Sneak Attack dice (rounded down) to the attack's damage.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Rat Tooth Dagger requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Venom
**[Hide]**: Bark
**[Natural Weapons]**: Claws from a Ratling

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

These pungent weapons are made of leather of dubious origin with clumps of fur still attached. The leather grip fits snugly over the knuckles, with rat teeth and bits of bone sticking out the outward facing side. It gives off an unpleasant odor.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with these magic weapons. While you are attuned to these weapons, you have Immunity to magical contagions. Any creature who takes damage from this Constitution saving throw or contract Sewer Plague. When you score a Critical Hit against a creature with these magic weapons, it takes an extra **2d4** Necrotic damage and has Disadvantage on saving throws against magical contagions for seven days.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

This sticky paste is fashioned from the powdered bone armor of a bone trader. After you treat a weapon, Shield, or other item that can be wielded in one or two hands with the paste, you can take a Bonus Action to summon and equip it, as long as the item is within 30 feet of you. After using this effect three times, it loses its potency.

When you drink this potion, you are filled with intense and violent vigor, gaining 3d8 Temporary Hit Points. For 1 minute, when one of your enemies dies within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to regain 1d8 Hit Points.
The base of this glass potion bottle is shaped like a skull, and the images of scythes run up its neck.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For 1 minute after drinking this potion, when you hit a *Bloodied* creature with an attack roll and deal damage to it, the creature takes an extra **1d8** Necrotic damage.

This magic shield is formed from the shell of an Anomollusk combined with leather from an aberration as its handle. It's fused together and coated in contaminated ichor and inset with a rare animus. Once complete, the shell gives off an otherworldly hue that shimmers in kaleidoscopic patterns. The shield can reflect attacks and magic.

When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, or Thunder damage from a creature you can see within 60 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to cause the creature to take the same damage (you still take the damage).

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Reflector Shield requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Contaminated Ichor
**[Hide]**: Shell from an Anomollusk
**[Hide]**: Skin from an Aberration

description.value: When you drink this bright purple potion, you immediately gain the benefits of a short rest.
After you consume a Rejuvenation Potion, you can't benefit from consuming another until you finish a 1d4 Long Rests.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Rejuvenation Potion requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Dust]**: Fey Dust
**[Fluid]**: Any Elemental Fluid
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Dragon
**[Organ]**: Heart from a Fiend

name: Repeater Crossbow

description.name: Range

You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition

The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Magazine
description.value: A weapon with the Magazine property also has a number and an ammunition type. The weapon holds that amount and type of ammunition, which you can expend before needing to reload the weapon. As a Bonus Action, you may remove a Magazine and then reload it with a new Magazine. A Magazine weapon comes with two empty magazines included in the weapon's cost and weight. An additional empty magazine for a Magazine weapon costs 25 GP. Loading an empty Magazine with ammunition takes 1 minute.

description.name: Repeater
description.value: Repeater weapons can fire ammo in quick succession, using multiple barrels or quick-reloading mechanisms. When you take the Attack action with a Repeater weapon, you can shoot multiple times if you have features that let you attack more than once as part of that action, such as Extra Attack. After taking the Attack action you can use a Bonus Action to attack once with the same weapon. You don't add your ability modifier to the Bonus Action's attack, unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

A Magazine weapon comes with two empty magazines included in the weapon's cost and weight. An additional empty magazine for a Magazine weapon costs 25 GP. Loading an empty Magazine with ammunition takes 1 minute.

description.name: Repeater
description.value: Repeater weapons can fire ammo in quick succession, using multiple barrels or quick-reloading mechanisms. When you take the Attack action with a Repeater weapon, you can shoot multiple times if you have features that let you attack more than once as part of that action, such as Extra Attack. After taking the Attack action you can use a Bonus Action to attack once with the same weapon. You don't add your ability modifier to the Bonus Action's attack, unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

properties: repeater weapons can fire ammo in quick succession, using multiple barrels or quick-reloading mechanisms. when you take the attack action with a repeater weapon, you can shoot multiple times if you have features that let you attack more than once as part of that action, such as extra attack. after taking the attack action you can use a bonus action to attack once with the same weapon. you don't add your ability modifier to the bonus action's attack, unless that modifier is negative.

description.value: This foul-smelling concoction is made from the remains of stinking sludge. As an action, you can throw the vial up to 10 feet, where it breaks and releases a noxious vapor that fills a 30-foot-radius Sphere. Each creature in the area with the Incapacitated, Stunned, or Unconscious condition ends those conditions. Each dying creature in the area has Advantage on its next Death Saving Throw. Each creature that was not dying and did not have any of those conditions must instead succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

These boots are crafted from the flesh and scales of a dragon and decorated with Harpy feathers and the webbed membranes of flying creatures. The soles are injected with goopy ooze, allowing their wearer to jump back in time and space.

You can use a Bonus Action on your turn to click the heels of these boots together. When you do, you teleport to the space you occupied at the start of your turn so long as it is currently unoccupied.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating Retracer Boots requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Goopy Ooze
**[Hide]**: Scales from a Dragon
**[Hide]**: Webbed Membrane
**[Hair]**: Feathers from a Harpy
**[Organ]**: Flesh from a Dragon

description.value: This mechanized shield retracts into a bracer worn on the forearm. With a quick motion, it can be expanded just as an opponent believes they've snuck a blow.

You can wear the Retractable Shield as a bracer on your forearm, and it does not count as having that hand occupied while the shield is retracted. As a Reaction to an attack hitting you, you can extend the shield, giving you a bonus to your Armor Class equal to your Proficiency Bonus against that attack. If this changes the attack from a hit into a miss, you may make one melee attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike against the provoking creature if they are within reach. The shield remains extended until the start of your next turn.
As a free interaction with an object on your turn, you can either extend or retract the shield. While the shield is extended, it occupies your hand and confers a +2 bonus to your Armor Class.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Returning
description.value: A Returning weapon allows you to hurl the weapon in such a way that it returns to you. When you make a ranged attack with a Returning weapon, the weapon returns to you immediately after hitting or missing the target. You can catch the weapon if you have a hand free to do so.

name: Revelry Suit

description.value: This bulky suit is made from natural materials, including fur, canvas, and straw. Its mask is exceptionally oversized and shaped into a sun, smiling in an unsettling way. While you wear this armor, you gain a +2 bonus to AC, and it grants the following properties.

description.name: Dancing Dodge
description.value: When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, if your Speed isn't 0, you can use this property to succeed instead. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Wild Steps
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

description.name: Dancing Curse
description.value: When you roll Initiative, you must make a DC 0 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you gain the Incapacitated condition, and your Speed is 0 until the start of your next turn as you perform a folk dance. When you use the Dancing Dodge or Wild Steps properties, the DC of the saving throw increases by 2. The DC of this curse can't increase again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

name: Revolver

description.value: An iconic handgun, the Revolver stores six bullets in a rotating cylinder. This weapon is favored by Gunslingers for its reliability and stopping-power.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Recoil
description.value: After you make an attack with this weapon, you can't make ranged attacks beyond the weapon's normal range until the end of the current turn.

description.name: Reload
description.value: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a Bonus Action.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.
after you make an attack with this weapon, you can't make ranged attacks beyond the weapon's normal range until the end of the current turn.

description.value: This ring has 6 charges and regains 1d6 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a Magic action and expend 1-3 charges to summon a number of empty Barrels in spaces within 5 feet of you equal to the number of charges expended. A Barrel provides Half Cover to a Medium or smaller target behind it and can be moved or set to rolling with a Utilize action. A Barrel has AC 15 and 20 HP.

If you summon a Barrel into a space occupied by a Medium or smaller creature, the creature must succeed on a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw to be trapped within the Barrel. It has Advantage on its saving throw unless its Speed is 0. A Medium creature trapped within a Barrel has the Restrained condition, whereas a Small or smaller creature has Total Cover from effects outside the Barrel. Bursting free of the Barrel requires a successful DC 20 Strength (*Athletics*) check as an action.

This rose gold band is set with an obsidian stone carved in the shape of a heart. While wearing this ring, you can use a Magic action to attempt to learn a creature's darkest desire. Select a creature that you can see. That creature must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, you immediately learn the target's greatest desire. On a successful save, you do not learn anything, and the creature is immune to the effects of the ring. If the creature you choose has an Intelligence of 3 or lower, the creature is unaffected. The ring's power can be used once and recharges at midnight.

This ring's crafting requires powdered brain from a restless lumberer. It has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a Bonus Action to expend 1 charge to change the damage type of the next spell you cast before the end of your turn to Psychic damage.
In addition, while attuned to the ring, you're Immune to spells or magical abilities that interfere with your sleep or cause nightmares while you sleep.

This ring is made of braided copper wire. While wearing this ring, your elemental energies are supercharged, allowing them to radiate from your body. When you cast a spell or use an ability that does Cold, Fire, or Lightning damage, the range of the spell or ability is doubled.
This golden band is stamped with images of smiling humanoid faces. While attuned to this ring, the wearer has Advantage on Search actions to make a Wisdom (*Insight*) check.
Additionally, you can take a Magic action to cast __Zone of Truth__ (save DC 15) with the ring. The ring can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
This rod is formed of stacked crystal spheres filled with smoke. The rod has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dusk.

When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages you while you are holding this rod, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 charge to force the creature to make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains 1 level of Exhaustion. If you have the Lich Transformation, the creature has Disadvantage on its saving throw, and you gain 2d10 Temporary Hit Points when a creature fails the save.

This rod appears to be a piece of driftwood carved with images of wolves and bears. While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to cast __Polymorph__ on any number of willing Humanoids you can see within 30 feet of you. The only forms you can choose for each target are __Black Bear__ and __Wolf__, and the targets retain their Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The effect lasts for 24 hours and requires no Concentration. You can take a Magic action to end the effect early for any number of targets.
Once you use the rod to cast __Polymorph__, it can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
If you have reached at least Stage 1 of the Lycanthrope Transformation, you can hold this rod in your teeth and use it while in hybrid or kindred form.

name: Rod of Wild Dominion
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Handling__)

description.value: This rod of varnished oak is capped at both ends with a Siberys dragonshard. While holding the rod, you can use any of its properties:

description.name: Dominion
description.value: You can cast __Dominate Beast__ from the rod. When you cast the spell in this manner, the duration increases to up to 1 hour. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for this spell. After the rod is used to cast this spell, it can't be used to do so again until the next dawn.

description.name: Handling
description.value: You have Advantage on Wisdom (*Animal Handling*) and Wisdom (*Survival*) checks.

description.name: Wild Speech
description.value: You can cast __Speak with Animals__ from the rod.

name: Runestone of the Wild Titan (Legendary)

description.value: This mighty granite runestone is etched with complex glyphs on much of its angular surface. Though an incredible burden to carry, it thrums with the power of the wild titan. The stone weighs 50 pounds.
While holding the stone, you gain a +3 bonus to Strength and Constitution saving throws determined by the runestone's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Crushing Weight (Rare+)
description.value: When you are within 5 feet of a creature with the Prone condition, you can take a Bonus Action to set the stone on the creature to give it the Restrained condition. The creature can take an action to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus), pushing the stone free and ending the Restrained condition on a success.

description.name: Boulder Throw (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can throw the stone as a Simple Ranged weapon using Strength for the attack and damage rolls. The stone has the Heavy and Thrown properties. It has a normal range equal to twice your Strength score and a long range equal to five times your Strength score. On a hit, it deals **2d10** Bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC = 16 + the stone's bonus) or have the Prone condition.

description.name: Recall (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can call the stone back to you, provided it is within 1 mile. If you have an empty hand, it appears in your hand; otherwise, it appears at your feet in your space.

description.name: Primal Vitality (Legendary)
description.value: While you stand on fertile soil or unworked stone, you have Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws, and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Strength modifier at the start of each of your turns.

description.name: Pummeling Boulder (Legendary)
description.value: The damage of the Boulder Throw property increases to 3d10, and the stone deals double damage to objects and structures.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Swift
description.value: Swift weapons help you recover quickly from missed attacks. When you miss with a Swift weapon, you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with the weapon against the same target before the end of your next turn. If that attack hits, it also deals an extra **1d4** damage of the weapon's normal damage type.

When you drink this potion, you take **2d4** Fire damage. For 1 hour, you have Resistance to Cold damage and whenever you deal damage with your Unarmed Strike, it can deal your choice of Fire damage or its normal damage type.
This potion is bright red and smells of hot peppers and spices. It is typically drizzled on food prior to eating but it is possible to consume it straight from the bottle.

This vial of red glass and gold filigree is useful to practitioners of blood magic. As part of the Attunement process, you fill the vial with your own blood. Choose up to 10 of your Hit Point Dice and roll them, reducing your Hit Point maximum by an amount equal to the result. This creates a pool of Hit Dice that you can expend in place of your own when you cast a Sangromancy spell.
Each time you finish a Long Rest, the pool is replenished, restoring a number of Hit Dice equal to half the number you rolled during Attunement.
If you end your Attunement to the vial, your Hit Point maximum returns to normal after you finish a Long Rest.

name: Scribing Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Scribing__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Scribing__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Scribing Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Scribing__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Scribing__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Scribing Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Scribing__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Scribing__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.
When you roll damage for a spell of level 1 or higher, you can expend this scroll to re-roll a number of the damage dice up to the level of the spell cast. You must use the new rolls.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Scroll of Spell Power requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Fey, Dragon, or Giant
**[Hide]**: Skin from a Monstrosity

name: Scythe of the Harvest Terror (Legendary)

description.value: This menacing scythe with a rusted blade was wielded by the Harvest Terror, a demon of secrets and fear. The scythe appears old and worn, with a handle wrapped in ancient, weathered cloth. The blade is etched with hatch marks, tallying its kills.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the scythe, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Feed on Fear (Rare+)
description.value: Once during your turn, when you attack with the scythe and hit a creature that has the Frightened condition, it takes an extra 1d10 (Legendary: 2d10) Psychic damage.

description.name: Sweep of Dread (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Fear__ (save DC = 16 + the scythe's bonus, no *Concentration* required) from the scythe. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Harvest of the Hidden Word (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can force one creature you can see that has the Frightened condition to make a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the scythe's bonus). On a failed save, you learn one fact that it deliberately keeps secret. The creature is then immune to this property for 24 hours.

description.name: Seed of Terror (Very Rare+)
description.value: Immediately after you hit a creature with the scythe, you can take a Bonus Action to force one creature within 30 feet of the creature you hit to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the Scythe's bonus). On a failed save, the creature gains the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Lurking Terror (Legendary)
description.value: When a creature you can see that has the Frightened condition ends its turn within 60 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space the Frightened creature can see.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Cleave
description.value: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

description.value: Immediately after you hit a creature with the scythe, you can take a Bonus Action to force one creature within 30 feet of the creature you hit to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 16 + the Scythe's bonus). On a failed save, the creature gains the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Cleave
description.value: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

properties: each fabled heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. the rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the heirloom rarity table. an heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. the heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: These steel arm blades are razor sharp, 4-foot-long scythes that are fastened to two locking bracers made of spinal bones. The fasteners are made from fine leather with steel buckles. Delerium crystals are embedded in the armbands, infusing the blades with energy.
These magic shortswords function as a pair and must be wielded together for their magic properties to function. Attuning to the shortswords counts as being attuned to one magic item.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with these magic shortswords. While attuned to these weapons, you can activate the Nick mastery property in addition to a different mastery property you're using with these weapons.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating Scythed Arm Blades requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Bones]**: Spine
**[Hide]**: Plates
**[Hide]**: Skin from any Beast or Monstrosity
**[Natural Weapons]**: Two Blades from a Reautomata

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Vex
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

This harness is woven from the hides of slain lycanthropes. When you attune to this item, the harness melds into your flesh, making it tough. Your Armor Class is 14 + your Dexterity modifier. When you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from a source that is not silver, you can use a Reaction to halve the damage (rounding down).
While you wear the harness, you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks to interact with lycanthropes.
This ornate silver hand mirror is decorated with a motif of withered roses. The mirror's reflection always shows the true form of any creature viewed in it as if the viewer had Truesight.
If the Seeing Glass is turned upon a vampire, the glass immediately shatters and is destroyed.

name: Sentinel Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Sentinel__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Sentinel__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Sentinel Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Sentinel__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Sentinel__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Sentinel Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Sentinel__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Sentinel__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Serpentine Mirror
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: The typical crystal ball, a very rare item, is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the __Scrying__ spell (save DC 17) with it.
These seven scrolls each cover a different topic concerning the relationship between the gods, the material world, and the planes. Those who master them can create doors to other worlds.

description.name: Language:
description.value: Celestial (XPHB).

description.name: Attunement Check:
description.value: Intelligence (*Religion*) DC 20. To end your Attunement to the Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan, you must visit each of the seven realms that it allows access to.

description.name: Benefits:
description.value: While attuned to the Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan, you gain the following benefits:

entries: If you have the spellcasting class feature, you can prepare one additional spell for each spell level you can cast. That spell must be chosen from the Cleric spell list.
You gain a +1 bonus to the DC of any spell you cast that is on the Cleric spell list.
You have Advantage on all Wisdom saving throws.
You gain one additional spell slot of the highest level you can use.

You can cast __Gate__ once per day without expending a spell slot. Wisdom is your casting ability for this spell. When you cast it, you open a gate to a location described in the books. If you use this feature again while at the location, the spell connects to the second location in the books. There are seven such locations, and using this feature at the seventh one returns you to the place where you first used this ability. The specific locations are left to the DM to decide, but legend has it that each is a domain of a long forgotten deity since claimed by agents of the Cthulhu Mythos.

description.name: Drawbacks:
description.value: You have an overwhelming drive to use the books to visit the realms it allows you to access. If you go a week without using the Gate feature, you gain a level of Exhaustion that you cannot lose until you cast __Gate__ using this item and travel through the portal you created.

description.name: Insight-Enemy of the Dark (+20):
description.value: You are an ardent foe of the Cthulhu Mythos. When you encounter their agents and entities, you are compelled to defeat them and drive them back to the dark corners of the cosmos that spawned them. You struggle to leave any location that has been overrun with their foul evil.

description.name: Lore:
description.value: The Seven Cryptical Books of Hsan allows you to automatically succeed all checks made to learn about dead gods.

This blade was forged in khaar'draguus, the lava pits below Sharn, and wielded by an ancient Dhakaani hero who fell in battle against the daelkyr Belashyrra. A sentience lies within the blade; it doesn't communicate with words, but while attuned, you can feel its emotions and desires. Shaarat'doovol was forged to protect the innocent from the machinations of the daelkyr, and if it feels you are serving that purpose, it can grant great power.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit an Aberration with this weapon, the Aberration takes an extra **2d10** Radiant damage.

description.name: Unyielding Duty
description.value: If you have the favor of the sword, it guides you and shields you from unnatural influences. While wielding this sword, it can choose to grant you the following benefits:

entries: **Truesight**: You gain Truesight with a range of 90 feet.
**Fortified Mind**: You have Immunity to the Charmed and Frightened conditions and Resistance to Psychic damage.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

name: Shadow Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Shadow__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Shadow Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Shadow__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Shadow Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Shadow__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

Crafted by Dyrrn the Corruptor, this black jewel-like object fuses to the center of your forehead when you attune to it. As a Bonus Action, you can cause the sibling to exude or retract an ectoplasmic shadow that surrounds your body and conceals you from prying eyes. While the shadow is active, Wisdom (*Perception*) checks made to see you have Disadvantage, and you have Advantage on Dexterity (*Stealth*) checks made to Hide.

In addition, when you are hit by an attack, you can take a Reaction to expend one Hit Die to shield yourself. Roll the die and add the result to your AC, including against the triggering attack. This bonus lasts until the end of your next turn.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.
Shadowsteel Focus is a Spellcasting Focus that contains some amount of Shadowsteel. Any Spellcasting Focus can be made as a Shadowsteel Focus.

There is no benefit to using a Shadowsteel Focus instead of a Spellcasting Focus; however, a spellcaster with the __Shadowsteel Adept__ and __Shadowsteel Master__ feats can gain the benefits associated with that feat when they use a Shadowsteel Focus.

Delerium is a magical mineral left behind by the meteor that landed in Drakkenheim. It appears in geode clusters of translucent, sharp-edged crystals which reflect octarine light. The eldritch stones softly hum in dissonant tones, and glow brightly at night or when exposed to magic. Deposits are found throughout Drakkenheim, often fused into stone streets and buildings like crystalline moss.
A typical delerium fragment is about the size of a finger. Crystals may be fist-sized or slightly larger, and geodes may be as big as a pumpkin. Massive clusters might grow taller than a human.

description.name: Delerium Properties
description.value: All delerium samples have the following traits regardless of size:

entries: Immune to Necrotic, Poison, and Psychic damage; as well as Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from non-magical weapons.
Resistant to Acid, Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage; as well as Slashing and Piercing damage from magical weapons.
Vulnerable to Bludgeoning damage from magical weapons.

Unless contained within an __Antimagic Field__, delerium shatters and crumbles into worthless ash when reduced to 0 Hit Points. However, delerium geodes release a random [Arcane Anomalies](https://5e.tools/tables.html#arcane%20anomalies_monstersofdrakkenheim) when destroyed.

description.name: Delerium Hazards
description.value: When a humanoid creature touches delerium without protective gear for the first time on their turn, or ends their turn in bodily contact with delerium, they must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or take **1d6** Necrotic damage and gain one level of Contamination.

description.name: Delerium Harvesting
description.value: Delerium found in Drakkenheim is usually fused into the ground or stone buildings. It is carefully extracted using handheld mining equipment such as shovels, picks, hammers, and chisels. Consult the table to determine how long it takes characters to extract delerium. Lacking proper equipment, extraction takes ten times as long. Massive clusters are impossible to extract without heavy equipment or powerful magic.

description.name: Uses for Delerium
description.value: Delerium has vast arcane potential. Beyond trade, crystals are used for several purposes:

description.name: Spell Component
description.value: Delerium may be used as an Arcane Focus or material component for any spell on the sorcerer, warlock, or wizard spell list. When casting a spell which requires a costly material component, a spellcaster may instead use delerium of equivalent or greater value to the required cost.

description.name: Magic Items
description.value: Delerium is an exceptional material for creating magical items of all kinds. Any existing magic item described in the Basic Rules could be made with delerium. Fragments, shards, crystals, and geodes may be used to make uncommon, rare, very rare, and legendary items respectively. At the GM's discretion, characters who can cast level 5 spells or higher may learn techniques to craft magic items of their own during their downtime.

description.name: Stable Delerium
description.value: The process for crafting magic items with delerium renders the crystals stable. Unless otherwise specified, characters do not take damage nor risk Contamination when they touch or handle stable delerium. Stable delerium is damaged and destroyed in the same manner as a normal magic item of its kind.

description.name: Delerium Dust
description.value: Delerium dust is made by grinding the crystals against one another to create a fine powder. This milling process is extraordinarily hazardous unless performed within an __Antimagic Field__. Delerium dust can be used in alchemy, as a spell component, a reagent for brewing potions, or mixed into inks used to scribe spell scrolls. Improvised Weapons & Ammunition. Delerium fragments may be used as ammunition for a Sling or fashioned into a makeshift Club. Such weapons and ammunition deal an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage, and humanoid creatures struck must make a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or gain one level of Contamination. Delerium used as ammunition in this way is destroyed.

name: Sheathed Staff

description.name: Double
description.value: A Double weapon functions as two Light weapons, one in each hand, for the purposes of two-weapon fighting. If a Double weapon has Reach, you can use only one of these properties per turn.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

properties: a double weapon functions as two light weapons, one in each hand, for the purposes of two-weapon fighting. if a double weapon has reach, you can use only one of these properties per turn.

description.value: Ammunition is required by a weapon that has Ammunition. A weapon's description specifies the type of ammunition used by the weapon.
Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

name: Shield of Marius Renathyr (Legendary)

description.value: Crafted from polished gold and white enamel and adorned with an intricate design of a rose encircled by thorny vines, this Shield was once owned by Marius Renathyr, a knight-errant destined for a terrible fate.
While holding this Shield, you gain a +3 bonus to AC determined by the Shield's rarity, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Valorous Guard (Rare+)
description.value: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to add 2 + the Shield's bonus to the creature's AC, potentially causing the attack to miss. When a creature within 5 feet of you fails a Dexterity saving throw, you can take a Reaction to add 2 + the Shield's bonus to the creature's total, potentially causing it to succeed.

description.name: Honor of the Vanguard (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you roll Initiative and an ally you can see is within 30 feet of an enemy, you can teleport to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that ally and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to 5 times the Shield's bonus.

description.name: Righteous Wrath (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you use the Valorous Guard property to cause an attack to miss, the next time you hit that attacker with a weapon or Unarmed Strike before the end of your next turn, it takes an extra 1d8 (Legendary: 3d8) Radiant damage.

description.name: As Terrible as the Dawn (Legendary)
description.value: You can cast __Flame Strike__ (save DC 19) from the Shield. If you are in the spell's area, you regain 5d6 Hit Points instead of taking damage. Once the spell is cast from the Shield, it can't be cast from it again until the next dusk.

The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. name: Shovel of Yorgrim (Legendary)

description.value: This shovel features a steel blade and collar at the end of a makeshift walking stick, appearing old and well-used. It was once the shovel of Yorgrim of the Shadestone Clan, who could commune with the spirits of the dead. It occasionally emits a faint whispering sound when handled.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the shovel, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Death-Kenning (Rare+)
description.value: When you hit an Undead with the shovel, you can take a Bonus Action immediately after the hit to learn its Resistances, Immunities, and Vulnerabilities, if any.

description.name: Deathspeaker (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Gentle Repose__ and __Speak with Dead__ from the shovel.

description.name: Deny Death's Touch (Very Rare+)
description.value: You and your allies within a 10-foot Emanation originating from you have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Bind Deathly Servant (Legendary)
description.value: When a Humanoid dies within 30 feet of you, you can take a Reaction to turn its soul into a __Specter__ that obeys your commands. If the Humanoid was Friendly to you when it died, you can turn the soul into a __Wraith__ instead. You can control one creature at a time with this property. The Undead disappears after 8 hours, when you create a new creature with this property, or when it dies.

description.name: Psychopomp (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you and one willing creature that isn't Undead that you touch become wraithlike until the end of your next turn. While wraithlike, you can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take **1d10** Force damage. If the creature you touch is Undead, it must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw or have Vulnerability to all damage until the start of your next turn. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.
