description.value: When you hit an Undead with the shovel, you can take a Bonus Action immediately after the hit to learn its Resistances, Immunities, and Vulnerabilities, if any.

description.name: Deathspeaker (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Gentle Repose__ and __Speak with Dead__ from the shovel.

description.name: Deny Death's Touch (Very Rare+)
description.value: You and your allies within a 10-foot Emanation originating from you have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Push
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

properties: each fabled heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. the rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the heirloom rarity table. an heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. the heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Swift
description.value: Swift weapons help you recover quickly from missed attacks. When you miss with a Swift weapon, you have Advantage on the first attack roll you make with the weapon against the same target before the end of your next turn. If that attack hits, it also deals an extra **1d4** damage of the weapon's normal damage type.

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of a __Detect Magic__ spell (no *Concentration* required) for 10 minutes, and during that time, you have Advantage on Wisdom (*Insight*) checks to discern hidden motives or deception.
This potion is stored in a round glass flask. An iron band wraps around the bottle, ornamented with a goat's skull.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For the duration, you also gain the effect of the __See Invisibility__ spell.

When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the __Silence__ spell (no *Concentration* required) as a 20-foot Emanation originating from you for 10 minutes, and for the duration, squid tentacles emerge from your mouth.
This sculpted clay jar is painted in a deep blue and adorned with squid tentacles. Uncorking it reduces all noise in the area as if you are underwater, and the liquid within is a coppery blue-green.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: For the duration, you can spit ink from your mouth as a Bonus Action. One creature within 30 feet of you makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target gains the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this property for the next 24 hours.

Created from the ichor in a potbelly's stomach-pot, this volatile concoction is effective at damaging inorganic substances. As a Magic action, you can hurl the serum at a Construct or an object that you can see within 30 feet of you. The target makes a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking **10d6** Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
Alchemical Ammunition carries an alchemical payload. Rather than hurling a vial, you fire Alchemical Ammunition from a Ranged weapon, using your normal attack bonus with that weapon.
Alchemical Ammunition is heavier than normal; the weapon's normal and long ranges are halved. The Alchemical Ammunition is destroyed once used, whether the attack hits or misses.

description.name: Acid
description.value: When one of these pieces of Alchemical Ammunition hits, it deals the ammunition's normal damage, then applies the effect of the listed item to the target. No saving throw is allowed against this effect.
Alchemical Ammunition carries an alchemical payload. Rather than hurling a vial, you fire Alchemical Ammunition from a Ranged weapon, using your normal attack bonus with that weapon.
Alchemical Ammunition is heavier than normal; the weapon's normal and long ranges are halved. The Alchemical Ammunition is destroyed once used, whether the attack hits or misses.

description.name: Alchemist's Fire
description.value: When one of these pieces of Alchemical Ammunition hits, it deals the ammunition's normal damage, then applies the effect of the listed item to the target. No saving throw is allowed against this effect.
This ammunition works like an Armor-Piercing Melee weapon, but you fire the ammunition as a projectile from a Ranged weapon.

When you hit with Blessed ammunition, the weapon's damage type becomes Radiant. Also, if the target is Fiend, Fey, or Undead, that creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, and the creature can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Designed to open wide wounds, such as with a broad-bladed arrowhead, Brutal ammunition works like a __Brutal__ Melee weapon.

When you hit with Desecrated ammunition, the weapon's damage type becomes Necrotic. Also, if the target is Celestial, Humanoid, or Plant, that creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn, and the creature can't take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Alchemical Ammunition carries an alchemical payload. Rather than hurling a vial, you fire Alchemical Ammunition from a Ranged weapon, using your normal attack bonus with that weapon.
Alchemical Ammunition is heavier than normal; the weapon's normal and long ranges are halved. The Alchemical Ammunition is destroyed once used, whether the attack hits or misses.

description.name: Holy Water
description.value: When one of these pieces of Alchemical Ammunition hits, it deals the ammunition's normal damage, then applies the effect of the listed item to the target. No saving throw is allowed against this effect.
When you hit with Incendiary ammunition, the target takes an additional **1d4** Fire damage.

Advanced Ammunition named after a damage type deals that damage type. Arrows and bolts can have wide heads that deal Slashing damage or blunt tips that deal Bludgeoning damage. A sling bullet can have facets that deal Piercing damage. All such ammo is heavier than normal; the weapon's maximum range while using it is halved.
Advanced Ammunition that has the Ranging property is lighter and better made than common counterparts. When you fire Ranging ammo, you can increase your weapon's normal range by 50 percent.
Alchemical Ammunition carries an alchemical payload. Rather than hurling a vial, you fire Alchemical Ammunition from a Ranged weapon, using your normal attack bonus with that weapon.
Alchemical Ammunition is heavier than normal; the weapon's normal and long ranges are halved. The Alchemical Ammunition is destroyed once used, whether the attack hits or misses.

description.name: War Oil
description.value: A target hit by a piece of Alchemical Ammunition packed with War Oil takes damage as normal for the ammunition, then becomes coated in War Oil for up to 1 minute. Alternatively, you can target a point, such as the ground or a wall, and on an attack roll against AC 10, cause the War Oil to spill out of the ammunition, creating a circular patch of the viscous substance with a 10-foot radius.

War Oil is slick and highly flammable. An area coated in War Oil counts as Difficult Terrain, and a creature that starting its turn in a coated area or enters the coated area for the first time on a turn must succeed a DC 10 Dexterity saving throw or gain the Prone condition and have its Speed reduced to 0 until the end of its turn. Additionally, if a creature or area coated with War

Oil is exposed to an open flame or some other source of Fire damage, the oil ignites. The ignited oil burns for two rounds, dealing **2d4** Fire damage to any creature or object who comes in contact with it, and an additional **2d4** Fire damage to any creature that ends its turn while in contact with it. An ignited creature can douse the flames by using an action.
After burning for two rounds, being doused, or remaining unlit for 1 minute, War Oil dries up and ceases to be slippery or flammable.

Ammunition with the Whistling property creates a high-pitched sound after firing. This sound is audible out to 300 feet from the ammo as it flies. Whistling ammo isn't heavier, but it catches the air with intricate baffles to create its sound, so its maximum range is half normal. Whistling ammo deals Bludgeoning damage.

As a Utilize action, you can throw this smoky glass vial to a space up to 30 feet away. When the vial breaks, the concoction creates a 10-foot-radius Sphere of smoke. The area is Heavily Obscured. The smoke lasts for 1d4 + 2 rounds, or half as long in a windy area.

name: Sniper Rifle

description.value: An instrument of ranged precision, the Sniper Rifle can take shots from distant, nearly invisible ranges.

description.name: Range
description.value: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have Disadvantage on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

description.name: Ammunition
description.value: You can use a weapon that has the Ammunition property to make a ranged attack only if you have ammunition to fire from it. The type of ammunition required is specified with the weapon's range. Each attack expends one piece of ammunition. Drawing the ammunition is part of the attack (you need a free hand to load a one-handed weapon). After a fight, you can spend 1 minute to recover half the ammunition (round down) you used in the fight; the rest is lost.

description.name: Firearm
description.value: You don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. Firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Loading
description.value: You can fire only one piece of ammunition from a Loading weapon when you use an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction to fire it, regardless of the number of attacks you can normally make.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Sighted
description.value: Attacking at long range with this weapon doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls. When you hit a creature with an attack using this weapon at long range, you can reroll any of the damage dice and must use the new roll.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: A soarsled is a crystalline disk 5 feet in diameter. It can carry a passenger through the air, using the same principles as the buttresses that sustain the towers of Sharn.

While within Sharn or another Syranian manifest zone, you can stand on the sled and take a Magic action to mentally activate it, causing it to hover beneath you. Once per turn, you can mentally command the hovering sled to move up to 30 feet in any direction. The sled can carry up to 400 pounds, and stops hovering when you step off it.
Each turn, you can take a Magic action to make a DC 12 Dexterity (*Acrobatics*) check, moving the sled up to an additional 60 feet on a success.

While outside a Syranian manifest zone, the plane's energies rapidly fade, and the Soarsled can only be activated once, by taking a Magic action. When it has been used to fly for a total of 10 minutes, or when you deactivate it by stepping off it, it loses its energy and can't be used again until it spends at least 8 hours in a Syranian manifest zone.

This smooth and weighty stone has a dusk-colored gem embedded in its center. When pressed to the chest of a creature who has been dead for less than one minute, the stone captures a fragment of the dead creature's soul for later use.

The Soulbond Stone has 3 charges. While holding the stone, you can expend 1 charge to cast __Speak With Dead__ with the stone, as if the trapped soul's corpse was the target of the spell. When the last charge is expended, the stone shatters and the soul fragment returns to its rightful place.

This small oval stone is engraved with Fernian glyphs. While you are holding the stone, you can take a Bonus Action to touch a candle, torch, small campfire, or similar object, instantly igniting it into flame.

These scarab-like symbionts, bred by the daelkyr Valaara, have brilliant, iridescent shells. To attune to it, you must place it on your head; during the process of Attunement, it burrows through your skull, establishing a psychic connection with you. While it lacks human consciousness, it possesses a strange alien sentience that responds to your desires. There are tales of rare Spellburrows that possess greater knowledge and sentience; such stories sometimes end with the Spellburrow consuming the brain of the wizard who pushed it too far—but these are surely just fanciful stories!

A Spellburrow knows one cantrip of the DM's choice drawn from the Sorcerer or Warlock spell list, and you can cast this cantrip as if you know it. In addition, a Spellburrow knows one level 1 spell and one level 2 spell from the same spell list its cantrip is from. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic class feature, you can cast these spells as if you had prepared them, and they don't count against the number of spells you can prepare. You can choose to use either your Intelligence modifier, or a spellcasting ability modifier you have gained from another source, for these spells.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

This wooden staff is made from the harvested claws of a braerog. It has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge and cause thorn-covered rose vines to sprout up, covering a 20-foot square centered on a point within 5 feet of you. This area becomes Difficult Terrain.
Once created, the briars are non-magical. They grow (or wither) as appropriate for the environment, just as a normal plant would.
The staff regains 1d6 + 4 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the staff turns into rose petals and is lost forever.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Staff of Farryn of the Greenwood (Legendary)

description.value: This twisted wooden staff is crowned by a trinket-adorned deer's skull. It was fashioned by Farryn before she delved into the dark lore of Gorthos. Soft, fragrant moss and earthy mushrooms grow along the staff's length.

While holding the staff, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls and your spell save DC determined by the staff's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Living Ward (Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Servant of the Cycle (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Cure Wounds__ (level 3 version) from the staff. When you do so, the next time you hit with an attack before the end of your next turn, the target takes an extra **1d10** Necrotic damage. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Cycle's Balance (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Revivify__ from the staff. When you do so, the next time a creature fails a saving throw against a spell you cast in the next hour, it and creatures of your choice within 20 feet of it take **4d10** Necrotic damage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sacrifice of Flesh (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a spell you cast restores Hit Points, you can take Necrotic damage up to twice the level of the spell that can't be reduced or prevented in any way. If you do so, the target regains additional Hit Points equal to three times the damage you take.

description.name: Death Blossom (Legendary)
description.value: When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you dies, you can take a Reaction to make flowers bloom around them. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet of the dead creature regain 4d8 Hit Points and gain 2d8 Temporary Hit Points. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.value: This ebony staff bears a bronze spear tip and additional blades carved to depict a winged scarab. The staff can be wielded as a magic spear that grants a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. You are considered proficient with this weapon while you are attuned to it, even if you aren't proficient with spears. While holding the staff, you gain these benefits:

entries: **Spell Power**: You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.
**Cull Subjects**: Humanoids have a -2 penalty to saving throws against your spells.
**Spell Shield**: You have Advantage on saving throws against spells that target only you.

description.name: Cursed
description.value: This staff is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. Until the curse is broken with __Remove Curse__ or similar magic, you are unwilling to part with the staff, keeping it within reach at all times. In addition, you have Disadvantage on attack rolls made with weapons other than this one.

While cursed, you must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw each day at midnight. On a failed save, your Hit Point maximum is reduced by 10 unless you are Undead. Your Hit Point maximum can only be restored by a __Wish__ spell. If your Hit Point maximum is reduced to 0 while cursed, you die and immediately rise as a __Wight__.

This ocular organ, harvested from a living Aberration, melds with the skull of its host. If you are a Humanoid, you can attune to this item by stitching it into your scalp during the Attunement process. At the end of this time, the stalk burrows into your skull and bonds with your brain. Non-Humanoids cannot attune to the Stalk Symbiote.
While attuned to this item, you gain the following benefits:

entries: **Symbiotic Senses**: You have Advantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) checks, and you do not have Disadvantage on Initiative rolls when surprised.
**Aberrant Power**: If you have achieved at least Stage 1 of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, you have blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

**Symbiote Link**: You cannot voluntarily end your Attunement to the Stalk Symbiote. If it is physically removed from your body, it regrows in 1d4 hours unless you receive a __Remove Curse__ spell before it grows back (which also ends your Attunement).

description.value: This heavy steel ring is set with a chunk of shimmering star metal. While wearing this ring, your appendages are crusted with iridescent star metal. Your Unarmed Strikes are considered magical and deal Force damage.

This black iron needle easily pierces the skin. If a creature's mouth is sewn shut with a Stitching Needle, it loses the ability to speak and cast spells with verbal components. The creature gains the ability to communicate with Telepathy out to a range of 60 feet.
Stitching the mouth of a willing, Unconscious, or Incapacitated creature takes 10 minutes. Removing the stitches takes 1 minute.

name: Storm Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Storm__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Storm__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Storm Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Storm__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Storm__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Storm Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Storm__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Storm__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Storm's Embrace
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Storm__)

description.value: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

This stained grey jacket has long arms reaching the floor and contains dozens of restraining straps. This magical jacket takes 10 minutes to don or doff. While wearing this item and not wearing armor or wielding a Shield, you add your Intelligence modifier to your Armor Class. Also, you can cast spells without using Somatic or Material components that don't have a GP value listed. You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons and Unarmed Strikes.

If you have reached at least Stage 1 of the Aberrant Horror Transformation, you may roll twice whenever rolling on the [Unstable Form table](https://5e.tools/tables.html#unstable%20form_grimhollowpg24) and choose either result.

name: Submachine Gun

description.value: Firing lighter, easier to control rounds, the Submachine Gun is an effective alternative to larger automatic weapons.

For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Reload
description.value: You can make a limited number of shots with a Reload weapon. You must then reload the weapon as an action or a Bonus Action.

description.name: Automatic
description.value: When you make an attack with this weapon, you can choose to make two attacks instead. These attacks are always made with Disadvantage, regardless of circumstance. You can't replace these attacks. If this weapon has Ammunition, these attacks use twice the normal amount of ammunition.

properties: you don't add your ability modifier to the weapon's damage, unless otherwise stated. firearm ammunition is destroyed upon use.

description.value: This suit of comfortable woolen clothes, made from the wool of the rare and dangerous poffer, includes a shirt, trousers or a kilt, and thick socks. While wearing the suit, you have Resistance to Lightning damage, and you don't suffer effects from extreme cold weather.

These black leather goggles are set with cloudy glass that completely obscures the eyes of the wearer. You can take an action to don or doff these goggles. While wearing these goggles, you ignore your Sunlight Sensitivity, as well as any other ill effects you would suffer due to exposure to sunlight. The goggles also block your Darkvision, preventing you from seeing in the dark.
This gnarled, oak staff ends in a crook reminiscent of a swan's neck. It is clearly ancient, and was only recently uncovered from deep within an elven ruin.
You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Once a day, if the wielder is reduced to 0 Hit Points, the Swansong Staff immediately animates (using the stats of an __Animated Broom__) to protect them. The weapon acts on the wielder's initiative. If the animated weapon is reduced to 0 Hit Points or if its wielder regains consciousness, it becomes inanimate once more.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.
While wearing these supple leather boots, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating Swashbuckler's Boots requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any
**[Dust]**: Fey Dust
**[Fluid]**: Elemental Fluid
**[Hide]**: Any

name: Sword of the Crimson Abbot (Legendary)

description.value: This powerful, fiendish sword was once wielded by the Crimson Abbot. While it was created as a gift that brought evil and malice to the corrupted former knight, it has lost its connections to the Crimson Rose. However, its evil origins still linger within. The sword is sleek and polished, with a blade that absorbs light. A blood-red ruby on the hilt is fitted within a setting of thorns and roses.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon determined by the sword's rarity. While holding the sword, you can use the following properties.

description.name: Blood Drain (Rare+)
description.value: When you hit a creature with the sword, it takes an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage.

description.name: Irresistible Hunger (Very Rare+)
description.value: Necrotic damage you deal ignores Resistance.

description.name: Vampiric Charm (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Charm Person__ (save DC = 16 + the sword's bonus, no *Concentration* required) from the sword. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Embrace of the Duchess (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can touch the sword to the body of a Humanoid that has been dead for 1 minute or less. The creature must succeed on a DC 19 Charisma saving throw (as if it were alive) or become a __Vampire Spawn__ that dies again at dawn. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Stolen Life (Legendary)
description.value: When you deal Necrotic damage with the Blood Drain property, you can expend and roll one Hit Points Die. You regain Hit Points equal to the number rolled plus the Necrotic damage dealt.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

properties: each fabled heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. the rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the heirloom rarity table. an heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. the heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: The dreadful talisman is crafted from the skull at the center of a gore elemental. When you kill a creature with a melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike while you wear the talisman, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points for 1 minute.
While you have any of these Temporary Hit Points, your melee weapon attacks and Unarmed Strikes deal an extra **1d6** Necrotic damage on a hit.

While you are holding this wand, your voice and other sounds you produce are three times as loud as normal. House Phiarlan makes use of a similar device, the Thunderous Amulet, that leaves the wearer's hands free.

These leather gloves are outfitted with the talons of fallen beasts and stitched together with the arcane stitching of apothecary creations. The gloves are then empowered by elemental magic, reinforced with bone, and powered by an animus.
While wearing these gloves, you gain Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and your Unarmed Strikes deal an additional **1d6** Piercing damage on a hit.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating Talon Gloves requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Elemental Fluid
**[Hair]**: Stitches
**[Hide]**: Skin
**[Natural Weapons]**: Claws

description.value: This cherry-sized bloodstone heart is the beating center of a poppet. While the stone is on your person, when you gain the Frightened condition, you can make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, you end the Frightened condition.

Also, when you make an Intelligence ability check while holding the stone, you can listen to it, gaining unusual insight or access to esoteric lore. If you do so, you gain Advantage on that Intelligence check. The Telltale Heart can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

This whip is made from the tentacles and guts of aberrant creatures, stitched to the webbed membranes of winged beasts and fused to the bark of a plant creature. Once the animus is placed, the tentacles begin to writhe and wriggle and the whip can latch and drag creatures along the ground with uncanny strength.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic whip, which has a reach of 20 feet.
Once per turn when you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack using this weapon, you can pull it 10 feet towards you.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Tentacle Whip requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Hair]**: Stitches
**[Hide]**: Bark
**[Hide]**: Webbed Membrane
**[Natural Weapons]**: Tentacles from an Aberration

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Reach
description.value: A Reach weapon adds 5 feet to your reach when you attack with it, as well as when determining your reach for Opportunity Attacks with it.

description.name: Slow
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

name: The Bag

description.value: This weathered old satchel has three tarnished silver buckles that hold it shut. There are faint bloodstains on the inside of the flap, and the bag occasionally ripples as if something inside is moving. The bag functions as a Bag of Holding and has the following additional properties.

description.name: Inhabitant
description.value: A __Lurker in the Dark__ lives in the bag's extradimensional space. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, the lurker vanishes and reappears in the bag at the next midnight. The lurker only dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by a creature holding a toy or stuffed animal once owned by a child. If the lurker is killed, the bag loses its magic, and anything in it appears in unoccupied spaces closest to the bag.

description.name: The Bag's Claw
description.value: While holding the bag, you can take a Bonus Action to have the lurker in the dark lash out with its claw at a creature within 5 feet of you. Make a melee attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, the claw deals **1d10 + 4** Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from the claw, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends. This property can be used three times, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Lurker's Curse
description.value: When you finish a Long Rest, roll 1d6. On a 1, the lurker slipped out of the bag during the rest and caused mayhem in a nearby area, such as attacking people, causing livestock to sicken, or spoiling provisions.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

description.value: A thin, leather-bound volume, The King in Yellow contains a dreamlike play that compels a reader to obsess over the text. They read the play again and again, slowly coming to believe that the disconnected scenes and strange vistas it describes are real.

description.name: Language:
description.value: Common (XPHB).

description.name: Attunement Check:
description.value: Charisma (*Performance*) DC 15. Unlike other tomes, you are compelled to make this check when inspecting The King in Yellow. If you succeed, you attune to the book. To end your Attunement to the King in Yellow, you must meet Hastur.

description.name: Benefits:
description.value: While attuned to The King in Yellow, you gain the following benefits:

entries: You gain Advantage on all Charisma (*Performance*) checks.
You gain Advantage on all Charisma (*Deception*) checks as long as your lie involves characters, scenes, and locations drawn from The King in Yellow.

You can cast __Contact Deity__. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell. Once you use this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest. When you cast that spell using this item, you always contact Hastur.

Each time you finish a Long Rest, roll a d20. On a 1 you can cast __Call Deity__ to summon Hastur. You lose access to this benefit if you finish a Long Rest without using it. If you do not use the spell, you gain a level of Exhaustion that cannot be removed while you are attuned to this item.

description.name: Drawbacks:
description.value: You have Disadvantage on all Wisdom (*Perception*), Wisdom (*Insight*), and Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks, as images of Carcosa dance in your mind, distracting you from the increasing unreal world around you.

description.name: Insight-Lost Carcosa (+20):
description.value: You must find lost Carcosa and gaze upon forgotten Lake Hali. There, in that dreadful realm, you will finally find peace. No matter the cost, you must find the path there. You see omens and signs of Carcosa in the strangest places. The depths of ancient dungeons. The entrails of a slain enemy. Every sign points you back to Carcosa, again and again.

description.name: Lore:
description.value: The King in Yellow allows you to automatically succeed all checks made to learn about Hastur and elements associated with it.

This magical spying device, designed by gnome engineers on behalf of the Ebon Syndicate, is composed of two crystal orbs. The Emitter Orb is marble-sized, making it easy to slip into your target's purse or pocket. The Receiver Orb is fist-sized.

You can take a Magic action and touch the two orbs together to activate them for 7 days. Once activated, the Emitter Orb begins capturing thoughts within a 5-foot Sphere centered on it. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a success, that creature is immune to the effect for 24 hours. On a failed save, the holder of the Received Orb becomes immediately aware of that creature's surface thoughts for 1 minute, even if it leaves the area.

This ornate hand mirror, made of carved iron and adorned with images of grasping hands, can be used to contact other planes. As a Magic action, you can speak the true name of an extraplanar being, such as a Fey, Fiend, or Celestial, into the mirror three times. This summons the named creature in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the mirror.

A creature summoned this way retains its free will, and there is no guarantee it views you as an ally. It cannot leave this plane for 1 minute, after which time it automatically returns to its home plane unless it has the means to travel between planes on its own, in which case it can choose to stay.

Bred by the daelkyr Valaara, this bizarre symbiont burrows into the palm of its host, secreting razor-sharp chitin blades that can also be used as throwing weapons. When you attune to the scarab, it fuses with one of your hands, visible only as an iridescent, chitinous growth on your palm.

For every attack you make as part of the Attack action on your turn, you can extrude a shard of razor-sharp chitin from the symbiont into your empty hand, using it for the attack. The shard counts as a magical Simple Melee weapon with which you are proficient. It has the Finesse, Light, and Thrown properties with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. On a hit, it deals **1d4** Piercing damage and **1d4** Acid damage. The shard dissolves as soon as it hits or misses its target.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

name: Thuranni Cloak
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Shadow__)

description.value: While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while your Speed is 0.

This rod is a magical Musical Instrument developed by the gnomes of Zilargo. While holding the rod, you can take a Magic action to produce auditory illusions that unerringly replicate the sound of any instrument with which you're proficient, with an effect similar to the __Minor Illusion__ spell, with the sound emanating from the rod. To determine the quality of the performance, make a Charisma check with the Musical Instrument you're replicating. If you are proficient with the Thurimbar Rod, you can produce unearthly music unlike any natural instrument.

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

The inner workings of this clockwork device are formed from gears forged from magical constructs gathered around a focusing lens, held together carefully by the needles of magical creatures. The animus used harnesses the energy of The Algorithm, a being of order and consequence, whose control over time and space ripples from the strange clockworks of the medallion.
This medallion has 3 charges. It crumbles to dust when you expend the final charge.

You can expend 1 charge from the medallion to take an extra action on your turn. Each time you do, you can roll 1d6. On a 1, at the end of your turn, you become unstuck in time and space as the medallion casts the __Maze__ spell on you. On a 6, the medallion regains 1d3 charges.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating the Time Dilation medallion requires a Legendary Workshop and the following Legendary Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Animus from The Algorithm*
**[Hide]**: Plates from a Construct
**[Natural Weapon]**: Any Needles
**[Organ]**: Eye from a Construct

description.value: ** At the Game Master's discretion, the animus could be any other Legendary Construct instead.*

When you drink this potion, you weep with inexpressible sorrow for 1 hour. During that time, you have Immunity to the Charmed condition, but your continued wailing prevents you from being silent. If you are Charmed when you drink the potion, the condition is suppressed for the duration. This glass bottle is topped with a small crypt angel carved from stone. The fluid within has the taste and consistency of tears and the colors of a rain cloud.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: Creatures within 10 feet of you that are Friendly to you also gain Immunity to the Charmed condition.
This carbonated liquid, a potent distillation of faerie magic, is bright fuchsia and tastes of autumn rain. A Humanoid who drinks a Toadstool Toddy has Immunity to Fire and Cold damage for 1 hour.

This coil of muscle terminates in a sharp barb. When you attune to it, this daelkyr-bred worm attaches to your throat and nestles under your tongue. You can take a Bonus Action to make an Unarmed Strike with the worm, using your choice of Strength or Dexterity for the attack. On a hit, you deal Piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice), instead of the normal damage of an Unarmed Strike. In addition, the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

name: Tooth of the Jinxed Leviathan (Legendary)

description.value: This tooth is razor sharp and can be wielded as a Dagger. Its "hilt" is wrapped in alligator hide, and the flat of its blade flickers with magenta hex magic in carved glyphs.

You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon determined by its rarity. While holding the tooth, you can use it as a Spellcasting Focus for your spells, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Jinx of Dire Fortune (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can force one creature you can see within 60 feet of you to make a Charisma saving throw (DC = 16 + the tooth's bonus). On a failed save, the target is jinxed for 1 minute. While jinxed, when the target makes a D20 Test and rolls an even number on the d20, it must reroll the d20 and take the new roll. On a successful save, you must make the same saving throw, becoming jinxed for 1 minute on a failure. This property can't be used again while another creature is jinxed by it.

description.name: Exposed Weak Spot (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you make an attack roll with the tooth, you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

description.name: Steal Unluck (Very Rare+)
description.value: When an enemy you can see within 60 feet of you makes a D20 Test with Advantage, you can take a Reaction to negate their Advantage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until a creature you can see makes a D20 Test and rolls a 1 on the d20, or until the next dusk.

description.name: Strange Fortunes (Legendary)
description.value: Each time you score a Critical Hit with the tooth against an enemy, the tooth gains a cumulative +3 bonus to damage rolls. This bonus is in addition to the bonus based on the tooth's rarity. When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll with the tooth, you take Force damage equal to the accumulated bonus. This property's damage bonus returns to +0 when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

On a failed save, the target is jinxed for 1 minute. While jinxed, when the target makes a D20 Test and rolls an even number on the d20, it must reroll the d20 and take the new roll. On a successful save, you must make the same saving throw, becoming jinxed for 1 minute on a failure. This property can't be used again while another creature is jinxed by it.

description.name: Exposed Weak Spot (Very Rare+)
description.value: When you make an attack roll with the tooth, you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

description.name: Steal Unluck (Very Rare+)
description.value: When an enemy you can see within 60 feet of you makes a D20 Test with Advantage, you can take a Reaction to negate their Advantage. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until a creature you can see makes a D20 Test and rolls a 1 on the d20, or until the next dusk.

description.name: Finesse
description.value: When making an attack with a Finesse weapon, use your choice of your Strength or Dexterity modifier for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls.

description.name: Light
description.value: When you take the Attack action on your turn and attack with a Light weapon, you can make one extra attack as a Bonus Action later on the same turn. That extra attack must be made with a different Light weapon, and you don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative. For example, you can attack with a Shortsword in one hand and a Dagger in the other using the Attack action and a Bonus Action, but you don't add your Strength or Dexterity modifier to the damage roll of the Bonus Action unless that modifier is negative.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.name: Nick
description.value: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the Attack action instead of as a Bonus Action. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

description.value: This large shield provides more protection than a typical shield. While wielding a Tower Shield, you gain +3 to Armor Class. If you use an action to set the Tower Shield, you have Three-Quarters Cover until the start of your next turn. Additionally, your Speed becomes 0 and cannot be increased during that time.
To wield a Tower Shield, you must have a Strength of at least 15 and your Speed is reduced by 10 feet while wielding the shield.

name: Toy Riverboat

description.value: This tiny, brightly painted boat is made in exacting detail, with smokestacks and a paddlewheel that turns, but it looks like a child's plaything. Studying it reveals a miniscule but unearthly passenger within the boat's cabin. The riverboat grants the following properties.

description.name: Passengers
description.value: As a Magic action, you and up to twelve other willing, Medium or smaller creatures you can see within 30 feet of yourself shrink to Tiny size and appear aboard the riverboat, along with up to 300 pounds of gear per passenger. The boat moves over water or other liquids at 3 miles per hour and doesn't require wind. You can travel this way for up to 12 hours a day. A passenger that leaves the boat returns to its normal size.

description.name: Unearthly Passenger
description.value: You can release the riverboat onto water to cast __Arcane Eye__ with it. The riverboat is the spell's sensor and only moves on water, but you can otherwise move it as normal for the spell.

description.name: Haunting Curse
description.value: When a creature leaves the riverboat, it must make a DC 0 Charisma saving throw, becoming cursed on a failed save. While cursed in this way, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom and Charisma ability checks and on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition. After you make this saving throw, the save DC increases by 2. This increase can't happen again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

description.value: A jasper effigy of a chicken's head rests at the top of this trident, and an egg-shaped amethyst is fixed to its base. It is a strange weapon, but is highly coveted by farmers and livestock owners.

This magic weapon has 4 charges, and regains 1d4 expended charges at dawn. When you use the Attack action with this weapon, you can immediately expend 1 of its charges to cast the __Polymorph__ spell (save DC 15) and transform your target into a hen (AC 10, HP 1, Speed 30 ft) for 1 hour. If you expend the weapon's last charge, roll 1d4. On a 1, yolk explodes out of the egg-shaped gem at the base of the trident and the weapon loses its enchantment.

description.name: Thrown
description.value: If a weapon has the Thrown property, you can throw the weapon to make a ranged attack, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If the weapon is a Melee weapon, use the same ability modifier for the attack and damage rolls that you use for a melee attack with that weapon.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

This potion is a bubbling, sickly, green-brown viscous soup that has the consistency of mucus. What appears to be the rotting eye of a troll floats in the potion. It smells acrid and nauseating and tastes even worse than it looks.
When you drink this potion, for the next minute, you regain 5 Hit Points at the start of your turn. The effects of this potion end early if you take Fire or Acid damage.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Trollblood Potion requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Fey Animus
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Troll
**[Organ]**: Eyes from a Troll

description.value: From the tip of its thick steel blade to the base of its golden handle, each knife shimmers with a buzz of illusory energy.

While wielding a pair of Turtle Dove Daggers, you can create an illusory copy of yourself as an Action twice per long rest. The illusion lasts for 1 minute, or until you take damage. The illusion appears in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 ft of you. You can take an Attack or Magic action on your turn to attack or cast a spell as if you were in the illusion's space, but you must use your own senses. As a Bonus Action, you can move the illusion up to 30 ft to a space you can see, but it must remain within 120 ft of you. Additionally, when both you and your illusion are within 5 ft of a creature that can see the illusion, you have advantage on attack rolls against that creature.

Ulmyr's Eye appears to be a crystal ball filled with ever-shifting smoke. Peering into the orb reveals hazy visions, many of which are disturbing.

description.name: Aspirant
description.value: At this tier of Attunement, you have the following benefits:

entries: You know the __Guidance__ cantrip and can cast it even if you don't have the Spellcasting class feature.

The orb has 12 charges. You can expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 18) from it: __Augury__ (2 charges), __Clairvoyance__ (3 charges), __Detect Thoughts__ (2 charges), __Divination__ (4 charges), or __Scrying__ (5 charges). The orb regains 2d4 + 4 expended charges at dawn.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: Your fears of the future diminish your attention in the present. While attuned to Ulmyr's Eye, you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (*Perception*) and Intelligence (*Investigation*) checks.

description.name: Adept
description.value: At the Adept tier of Attunement, you have the following additional benefits:

entries: While holding the orb, you can use your Reaction to give Advantage or Disadvantage on a roll when a creature you can see within 60 feet makes D20 Test. The triggering creature rerolls and uses the new result. You can use this property a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.
While holding the orb, you can expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of your prepared spells without expending a spell slot. The number of charges expended is equal to the spell's level.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: Ulmyr's Eye fills your dreams and meditations with nightmarish visions, making it difficult for you to rest. When you finish a Long Rest, you must succeed a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or gain only the benefits of a Short Rest instead.

description.name: Master
description.value: While at the Master tier of Attunement, you have the following additional benefit:

entries: While holding the orb, you can cast the __Foresight__ spell from it, requiring no Material component. When you cast the spell in this way, its duration is reduced to 1 hour. Once you have done so, you can't cast the spell from the orb again until you finish a Long Rest.

description.value: You also gain the following curse:

entries: You are so filled with dread that you suffer frightful visions difficult to discern from reality. When you roll Initiative, the orb casts __Phantasmal Killer__ on you (save DC 14). This effect can also be triggered by moments of extreme emotional or physical distress, at the GM's discretion.

description.value: This iron token is inlaid with a sliver of a Siberys dragonshard. Most are worn as brooches, but others take the form of coins or keys. While an Uul'kur is a Common magic item, the secret of their creation is known only to the chot'uul monks of the Heirs of Dhakaan, and they are largely unknown in the Five Nations.

When you sleep with an Uul'kur on your person, you remain fully lucid when you dream, and when you wake, you clearly remember everything that transpired. If you understand the workings of the Uul'kur, you can take a Magic action to bind it to your dreams until the next dawn. While bound, any creature who sleeps with this token on its person shares your dream instead of creating its own, provided you are asleep at the same time.
(Requires the __Mark of Handling__)
This ring has 3 charges, and it regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save DC 13) from it:

entries: __Animal Friendship__
__Fear__ (affects Beasts only)
__Speak with Animals__

description.value: This potion is a crimson-red bubbling brew that tastes distinctly of copper. When you drink this potion, you gain the following benefits for the next minute:

entries: You gain Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Charisma attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

If damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points, you must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + half the damage taken, unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a success, you drop to 1 Hit Point instead, and the effects of this potion end.
The effects of this potion end early if you take Radiant damage or enter sunlight.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Vampire Blood Potion requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Undead Animus
**[Dust]**: Undead Dust from any Vampire
**[Fluid]**: Ectoplasm
**[Fluid]**: Monster Blood from a Vampire

name: Veil of the Weeping Widow (Legendary)

description.value: This mourning veil is imbued with alien power. The Weeping Widow wore the veil to hide her permanently tear-stained face, and rumors circulate that the widow used it to hide the otherworldly corruption writhing within her eyes.
While wearing the veil, you gain a +3 bonus to Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws determined by the veil's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Psychic Fortitude (Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

description.name: Sense Grief (Rare+)
description.value: You can cast __Detect Thoughts__ (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus) from the veil.

description.name: Psychic Shock (Very Rare+)
description.value: When a creature forces you to make a saving throw against Psychic damage, or to avoid or end the Charmed or Frightened conditions, you can take a Reaction to deal **2d8** Psychic damage to it.

description.name: Thought Worm (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can use the veil to cast __Modify Memory__ (save DC = 16 + the veil's bonus). When a creature fails its saving throw against the spell, you can implant a parasitic spawn of the White Worm in the target's brain. While you're on the same plane, you know the distance and direction to the target, and you can cast Divination and Enchantment spells on it as if it were in range and in sight. A Greater Restoration or __Heal__ spell kills the parasite and ends this effect. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Psychic Storm (Legendary)
description.value: You can take one extra Reaction during a round, which you can only use to activate the Psychic Shock property.

description.name: Veiled Countenance (Legendary)
description.value: When you are the target of a Divination spell, the caster must succeed on a DC 19 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the caster takes **6d8** Psychic damage and has the Incapacitated condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the caster's turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

description.value: This smoky concoction is a favorite of poisoners and assassins. You can use a Magic action to throw this vial up to 30 feet away from you, at which point it breaks and releases a dark vapor that fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on it for 2 rounds. A creature that enters the area or starts its turn there loses any Resistance or Immunity to Poison damage and has Vulnerability to Poison damage. This effect lasts for 1 minute.

name: Visage of the Old Ways (Legendary)

description.value: This wood-carved mask has a haunted expression and makes the wearer's eyes look like empty shadows. Rabbit ears protrude over the head. While you wear the mask, you hear the whispers of an ancient forest archfey deep within your mind.
While wearing the mask, you gain a +6 bonus to your damage rolls when you deal Fire damage determined by the mask's rarity, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Cultic Mask (Rare+)
description.value: You can't be targeted by Divination spells or perceived through scrying sensors. Ability checks made to discern your identity have a minimum DC of 25.

description.name: Fire Within (Rare+)
description.value: While you are burning, your weapon attacks deal an extra **2d4** Fire damage. You can take a Bonus Action to begin or stop burning.

description.name: Strange Sight (Rare+)
description.value: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet, and you can see normally through areas obscured by smoke.

description.name: Mastery of Flame (Very Rare+)
description.value: Fire damage you deal ignores Resistance.

description.name: Sacrificial Flame (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can cause a creature you can see with 0 Hit Points that is within 30 feet of you to burst into flame. Its body burns to ash over the next minute, and when a creature Hostile to you starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the body, it takes **2d8** Fire damage. The flame is extinguished if the target regains any Hit Points.

description.name: Harvest Offering (Legendary)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can expend up to 5 Hit Point Dice to regain a spell slot of a level equal to the number of Hit Dice spent. Alternatively, you can touch a creature that is willing or that has the Unconscious condition and force them to expend any number of these Hit Point Dice in your place. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.
