description.value: This small carved stone is typically bound to a leather strap worn around the wrist or neck. Designed by the Dhakaani duur'kala, the Vola'khesh facilitates communication between elite units. They are created in linked sets; up to ten stones can be bound together, and once established, this link cannot be changed. At present, the Vola'khesh are only used by the Kech Dhakaan and are unknown to the people of the Five Nations. If the enchantments were replicated, these tools could be put into use by spies and law enforcement agencies of the Five Nations.

While wearing a Vola'khesh, you can take a Bonus Action to whisper a message. This message is heard by all creatures within 120 feet wearing a linked Vola'khesh. Magical silence, 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or 3 feet of wood will block this effect, but the magic doesn't have to follow a straight line and can travel freely around corners or through openings.

*The chot'uul monks, who guard the dreams of Dhakaan, craft objects that are drawn to Dal Quor with a dreamer. When you dream, your Kra'uul objects accompany you. The physical object remains with your body in Eberron, but the idea of it travels with you and you can use it while exploring Dal Quor.*
*Any Kra'uul made of an otherwise-mundane object is a Common magic item. Kra'uul made of other magic items are the same rarity as the standard version. While the techniques of crafting Kra'uul objects are known only to the chot'uul, the DM can introduce other dreambound objects. A cursed sword might follow its bearer even into dreams, while a powerful Artifact could be even more glorious when seen in Dal Quor.*
Light glistens across this shiny, black wand; the ribbons that flow from its tip twinkle and sparkle in rhythmic patterns.

You can spin and twirl holding this wand to cast the __Otto's Irresistible Dance__ spell (save DC 14). The wand can be used to cast the spell as many times as you like each day, however, once a creature fails its saving throw against the spell cast by this wand, the wand cannot be used to cast the spell again until dawn the next day.
This wand is carved from magical bark, with the hair of an undead creature in its core and finished in goopy ooze.
Once per turn when you deal damage with a Warlock cantrip to a creature, you can make that creature Jinxed (1d4) until the start of your next turn.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Wand of Jinxes requires a Rare Workshop and the following Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Fluid]**: Goopy Ooze
**[Hair]**: Hair from an Undead
**[Hide]**: Bark

description.value: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast __Silence__ from it (save DC 15). The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Wand of the Poltergeist
type: very rare (requires attunement by a Spellcaster)

description.value: This wand is a swirl of dark and white wood, topped with a carved screaming skull. The wand has 7 charges.

With the wand in hand, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: __Animate Objects__ (4 charges), __Major Image__ (3 charges), or __Shatter__ (2 charges).

description.name: Regaining Charges
description.value: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dusk. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 20, the wand explodes into splinters and is destroyed.
Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature using a cantrip while holding this wand, one target of that cantrip takes an extra **1d4** damage of the type dealt by the spell.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Wand of the Precocious Apprentice requires an Uncommon Workshop and the following Uncommon Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any
**[Bones]**: Bones from an Undead
**[Dust]**: Fey Dust
**[Fluid]**: Ectoplasm

description.value: This disturbing daelkyr-made symbiont is a leathery tentacle with one end terminating in a single bulbous eye, and the other sporting a barb designed to burrow into flesh. When you attune to the eye, it burrows into one of your shoulders, then rises up from it, studying the world and projecting insights into your mind. The eye may occasionally take an interest in some random element of your current environment; in this case, the DM may draw your attention to this object or person.
While the eye is uncovered, you gain the following benefits.

description.name: Always Vigilant
description.value: The eye remains watchful while you sleep. When you take a Long Rest, the eye remains active, allowing you to use your Passive Wisdom (*Perception*) score to notice threats even while asleep. If the eye spots danger, it sends you a mental alarm in the form of a nightmare that immediately wakes you up.

description.name: Periscopic Vision
description.value: The eye can stretch up to 18 inches and can be used to peer around corners or over cover. When extended and used in this way, the eye has an AC of 20 and 6 Hit Points. If it is forced to make an ability check or a saving throw, it uses your statistics. If it is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you cannot benefit from any of the eye's properties until you finish a Short or Long Rest, after which it regains all lost Hit Points.

description.name: Third Eye
description.value: When you make a Wisdom (*Perception*) or Intelligence (*Investigation*) check involving sight, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the ability check.

description.name: Symbiotic Nature
description.value: Once you attune to this symbiote, you can't remove it unless you are targeted by a __Remove Curse__ spell or similar magic.

Aundair developed this staff to help wandslingers match the range of Thrane archers, but it quickly spread across Khorvaire. While holding this staff in both hands, you can use it as an Arcane Focus. Any cantrip cast using the staff can be cast at up to four times the standard range. However, when you cast a cantrip at more than twice the standard range, your attack rolls have Disadvantage, and targets have Advantage on saving throws made against your cantrip. For example, a __Fire Bolt__ cast using this staff has a range of 480 feet, but attack rolls against targets more than 240 feet away are made at Disadvantage.

description.name: Versatile
description.value: A Versatile weapon can be used with one or two hands. A damage value in parentheses appears with the property. The weapon deals that damage when used with two hands to make a melee attack.

description.name: Topple
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, the creature has the Prone condition.

name: Warding Brooch
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: While wearing this brooch, you have Resistance to Force damage, and you have Immunity to damage from the __Magic Missile__ spell.

name: Warding Channeling Wand
type: rare (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: This short metal wand is tipped with a Siberys dragonshard.

A Channeling Wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can cast any spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the other spells you can cast using your Dragonmark feat. You can expend additional charges to enhance the spell, choosing one of the following effects:

entries: **Casting Time**: You expend 2 charges to change a spell that normally has a casting time of 1 Magic action to instead be cast as a Bonus Action.
**Duration**: You expend 1 charge to double the duration of the spell, to a maximum of 24 hours.
**Range**: You expend 1 charge to double the range of the spell. If the spell normally has a range of Touch, you can cast it with a range of 30 feet.
**Regaining Charges**: The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

name: Warding Dragonmark Channel
type: common (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: This brooch is embedded with a small Siberys dragonshard, usually depicting the crest of its dragonmarked house.
While wearing a Dragonmark Channel, you can use it to cast any level 1 spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list. Once you use the channel, it can't be used again until you finish a Long Rest.
Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

name: Warding Dragonmark Reservoir
type: uncommon (requires attunement by a Creature with the __Mark of Warding__)

description.value: Dragonmark Reservoirs are always embedded with a Siberys dragonshard, but come in many forms, most commonly an amulet or bracelet bearing the design of the house crest.

A Dragonmark Reservoir has 7 charges. While wearing it, you can use it to cast any spell on your __Mark of Warding__ list at 1st or 2nd level, expending a number of charges equal to the level of the spell you cast. The reservoir regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is the same as the spellcasting ability for the spells you can cast with your Dragonmark feat.

This black tapered candle cannot be lit. When a Celestial, Fey, Fiend, or Undead comes within 120 feet of the candle, its wick ignites and burns with a purple flame. Once the candle has ignited, it burns for one hour, and it cannot be used again. Watcher's Candles cannot function if they are wrapped in packaging or stowed in a container.

This large greataxe is made from a blade taken off a Ripper and refitted into a housing made from the plates of constructs and reinforced with the rib bones of a monstrosity. The blade is equipped with a leather belt that connects to an elemental-fueled motor powered by a Very Rare Animus.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
Once on your turn when you hit a *Bloodied* creature using this weapon, you can make one additional attack with this weapon as part of the same action.

description.name: Crafting
description.value: Creating a Whirling Bonesaw requires a Very Rare Workshop and the following Very Rare Components:

entries: **[Animus]**: Any Animus
**[Bones]**: Ribs
**[Fluid]**: Elemental Fluid
**[Hide]**: Plates
**[Hide]**: Skin from any Monstrosity
**[Natural Weapon]**: Blade from a Ripper

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Cleave
description.value: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

name: Whistle of the Vagrant (Legendary)

description.value: This tarnished brass whistle belonged to the conductor of the Ghostlight Express, imbuing it with ghastly, mysterious powers. Its metal is cold to the touch, and its sound is an unnerving shriek.
While you hold or wear the whistle, you gain a +3 bonus determined by the whistle's rarity to all saving throws, and you can use the following properties.

description.name: Call the Dead (Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can blow the whistle to cast __Gentle Repose__ on all dead bodies within 30 feet of you. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Sense the Undead (Rare+)
description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can detect the presence and location of Undead within 60 feet of you, even through Total Cover of any material other than iron or lead.

description.name: Undaunted (Rare+)
description.value: You have Advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

description.name: Call the Undead (Very Rare+)
description.value: As a Magic action, you can blow the whistle to cast __Banishment__ against an Undead creature (save DC = 16 + the whistle's bonus) from it. The target always appears in a harmless demiplane resembling the interior of a train. If you maintain the spell for its full duration, the target arrives in an appropriate afterlife. Creatures with Legendary Actions automatically succeed on the saving throw. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Steam Cloud (Very Rare+)
description.value: You can blow the whistle to cast __Fog Cloud__ (no *Concentration* required) from it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dusk.

description.name: Touched by Death (Very Rare+)
description.value: You have Resistance to Necrotic damage.

description.name: Afterlife Express (Legendary)
description.value: You can blow the whistle to cast __Ghastly Charge__ (takes the form of a ghost train) from it. This property can be used twice, regaining all expended uses daily at dusk.

description.name: Fabled Heirloom
description.value: Each Fabled Heirloom is a magic item that grows in strength as its attuned owner gains power. The rarity of each heirloom increases as the character grows in level, as shown on the Heirloom Rarity table. An heirloom's description details the properties it always has, as well as the properties it gains as it increases in rarity. The heirloom has all the properties of its rarity and lower.

description.value: (Requires the __Mark of Scribing__)

Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast __Sending__ from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell.
Once Sending is cast using either stone, the stones can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

entries: **Ability**: Charisma
**Utilize**: Exchange messages of up to 10 words with an Ethereal creature within 30 feet (DC 15).

description.value: A witchboard is a slat of wood covered with letters, usually the Common alphabet though versions for different scripts are available. You can use it to contact Ethereal creatures, allowing limited conversations with them.

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have Advantage on the check too.

name: Withered Hand

description.value: The skin of this desiccated hand on a looped leather cord is covered with tattoos signifying dreadful hexes. The fingers seem to curl slightly when the hand is at the edge of your vision. While you hold or wear the hand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs. The hand grants the following properties.

description.name: Withering Grasp
description.value: When you make an Unarmed Strike, you can extend your reach to 30 feet with threads of magenta jinx magic. When you do so, on a hit, you deal Necrotic damage instead of Bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature no more than one size larger than you, you can give it the Grappled condition with the threads. The escape DC for this grapple can use your spellcasting ability or Charisma (your choice) in place of your Strength. The Grappled condition ends if you use this property against a different target.

description.name: Withering Curse
description.value: When you use the Withering Grasp property, your Hit Point maximum decreases by 1. Your Hit Point maximum can't decrease again until you finish a Long Rest. You don't regain the Hit Point maximum lost to this curse when you finish a Long Rest.

description.name: Lingering Curses
description.value: Ending your Attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a Cursed Curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. If you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your Attunement.

properties: ending your attunement to one of these items removes its curse, but the power of a cursed curio doesn't release its hold on the user easily. if you attune to it again within 28 days, the progression of its curse returns to where it was before you ended your attunement.

description.value: Aphaeleon is the Arch Seraph of temperance and spiritual balance, a patron to many monks. While wearing these simple cloth fist wraps endowed with his blessing, you can spend 3 Focus Points on your turn to end the Incapacitated, Paralyzed, or Stunned condition on yourself (no action required).

name: Wrath Axe

description.name: Hafted
description.value: A Hafted weapon's haft can function well as an off-hand attack. After you use the Attack action to attack with a Hafted weapon, you can use a Bonus Action to make a melee attack with the haft. The haft deals **1d6** Bludgeoning damage, and you add your ability modifier to damage.

description.name: Heavy
description.value: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls with a Heavy weapon if it's a Melee weapon and your Strength score isn't at least 13 or if it's a Ranged weapon and your Dexterity score isn't at least 13.

description.name: Momentum
description.value: Momentum weapons allow you to deliver devastating attacks as part of rapid movement. When you hit with a Momentum weapon after you moved 20 feet or more in a straight line during the same turn, upgrade the damage dice to the weapon's Momentum Dice value.

description.name: Two-Handed
description.value: A Two-Handed weapon requires two hands when you attack with it.

description.name: Brutal
description.value: A Brutal weapon is designed for maximum damage. Brutal weapons score Critical Hits on a natural roll of 19 or 20. If your Critical Range is already increased, instead increase it by 1 point (such as from 19-20 to 18-20).
When you score a Critical Hit with a Brutal weapon against a creature, the weapon deals one additional die of damage.

description.value: As a Bonus Action, you can coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition with this sticky sap and choose a damage type: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder. A creature that takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition takes an extra **3d8** damage of the chosen type. Once applied, the sap retains its potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.
Wytchwood Sap is stored in small vessels made of bark with a wooden stopper that never fully contains this oozing, amber-hued tar.

description.name: Heightened Potency
description.value: If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, another creature of your choice within 30 feet of your target takes **2d8** damage of the same type.
This punch knife stands out from others being made of a dark wood that's harder than iron.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with this weapon, you can roll and expend a Hit Point Die. The target takes extra Piercing damage equal to the roll, and you regain the same number of Hit Points.

description.name: Sap
description.value: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

This warhammer glows with an inner light. When the celestial realm nearly fell, a heavenly smith received a vision, to craft a hammer like no other. With the might of Zeal, heaven's armies turned back their foes, restoring the cosmic balance.

Zeal lies lost somewhere in Etharis, waiting to be wielded against the forces of darkness. The celestials don't realize that the forces of darkness hold an equally powerful weapon, as the fates that inspired Zeal's creation sent a similar vision to an infernal weaponsmith to maintain the balance of power.

description.name: Hammer of Heaven
description.value: This magic warhammer grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it. When you hit with it, the target takes an extra **2d10** Radiant damage.

description.name: Champion of Good
description.value: While holding Zeal, you have Immunity to the Charmed, Frightened, Paralyzed, and Stunned conditions.

description.name: Zealous Pursuit
description.value: You can take a Bonus Action to toss the hammer into the air, causing it to hover magically in your space. While the weapon hovers, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to fly up to 50 feet to another spot within 50 feet of you. As part of the same Bonus Action, you can either grasp the weapon if it is within reach, or cause it to attack one creature within 5 feet of the weapon. The weapon uses your attack roll and adds your ability modifier to the damage rolls. The weapon ceases to hover if you grasp it, if you are more than 50 feet away from it, or if you die.

description.name: Spells
description.value: While the hammer is on your person, you can cast __Beacon of Hope__, __Earthquake__, or __Heroism__ (save DC 18) from the weapon. Once you use Zeal to cast a spell, that spell can't be cast again from it until the next dawn.

description.name: Destroying the Hammer
description.value: The only thing capable of damaging Zeal is its fiendish twin Ardor. A creature wielding Ardor can choose to attack Zeal, which has an Armor Class of 21 and 300 Hit Points. No other creature or object can damage Zeal.
